params.description: First name, at most 50 characters; runs of spaces are collapsed and the ends trimmed. Must not be blank when sent. Required when your profile has no first name yet.

params.name: last_name
params.description: Last name, at most 50 characters; runs of spaces are collapsed and the ends trimmed. Must not be blank when sent. Required when your profile has no last name yet.

params.description: New login email, at most 100 characters. Starts the verification flow described above; the old address stays in use until the link is clicked.

endpoints.title: Generate Content with AI
endpoints.summary: Generate post text from a prompt, with multi-turn follow-ups to refine it.

params.name: prompt_text
params.description: What to write, up to 5000 characters. On a follow-up call this is the refinement instruction, for example Make it shorter and add emojis.
params.example: Write a social media post about our summer sale on cold brew

params.name: ai_id
params.description: Encrypted chat id returned by the previous call. Send it to continue that chat; leave it out to start a new one. Must be a chat of the workspace owner's account. Requires chat_progress and chat_history.

params.name: chat_progress
params.description: Encrypted progress marker returned by the previous call. It is a check value on chat_history: the history you send must be the one the marker was issued for. Required with ai_id.

params.name: chat_history
params.description: The chat_history array of the previous response, unchanged: objects with role (user or system) and content. A JSON body array or a JSON string. Required with ai_id. Do not append your new prompt yourself; send it in prompt_text.

example.content: Write a social media post about our summer sale on cold brew
Beat the heat with 20% off every cold brew this week. Grab yours before the sun does.

params.description: Workspace to act in. Defaults to your default workspace. Get ids from /api/workspace_list.

endpoints.title: AI Templates Generate
endpoints.summary: Write a post from an AI template with your answers, and refine it.

params.name: template_id
params.description: Encrypted template id from /api/ai_templates_list.

params.name: format
params.description: The text of one of the template's formats (from /api/ai_templates_formats), up to 2000 characters.
params.example: A short post with one call to action

params.name: answers
params.description: Your answers to the template's questions, as an object {question label: answer} or an array of {question, answer}; 1 to 30 entries, each question 1 to 500 characters (not a plain number) and each answer up to 5000 characters. A JSON body value or a JSON string.

params.name: instruction
params.description: Extra guidance for the writer (length, audience, words to avoid), up to 2000 characters; longer text is cut.
params.example: Keep it under 60 words and end with a question

params.name: question
params.description: On a refinement, what to change in the answer (1 to 5000 characters), sent with chat_id and history. Leave it out on the first generation.
params.example: Make it shorter and add a question at the end

params.name: chat_id
params.description: Encrypted chat id returned by an earlier answer of this or another AI endpoint (the same value /api/generate_content_with_ai calls ai_id). params.name: history
params.description: The history array of the previous response, unchanged: up to 40 turns of {role, content} where role is user or assistant and content is 1 to 20000 characters. Required with chat_id. A JSON body array or a JSON string. Do not append your new question yourself.

example.content: Write a launch post for the Acme hand grinder.
Meet the Acme hand grinder: cafe-grade grounds from a tool that fits in a jacket pocket.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Workspace to act in. Defaults to your default workspace. Get ids from /api/workspace_list.

params.name: url
params.description: Link to share with the post. On a text post the page's title, description and image are fetched and saved as the link preview; when omitted, the first link found in message is used instead. On a Pinterest account the value becomes the pin's destination link. http:// is prepended when the scheme is missing. The host must be a public address.

params.name: image_url
params.description: Image URLs, in display order. Send a JSON array (or repeat image_url[] in form encoding); a single string is accepted as a one-item list. At most 20 images. Each URL must be a publicly reachable http or https URL and answer an image content type. URLs already on RecurPost storage (for example from /api/media_list) are used as they are; every other URL is copied to RecurPost storage unless host_images_on_recurpost is off. May be combined with video_url into a mixed post, ordered by media_order.

params.name: video_url
params.description: A public mp4 or mov URL (Google Drive share links are accepted and resolved to the download URL). The file is downloaded and stored on RecurPost storage, so the call takes as long as the download; a URL already on RecurPost storage skips the download. Needs a paid plan. Files are limited to 2 GB.

params.name: media_order
params.description: The order of a mixed post's media as a list of the original URLs given in image_url and video_url. Media left out of the list follow, video first. Only read when both images and a video are sent. Any URL not in image_url / video_url answers 400.

params.name: host_images_on_recurpost
params.description: Copy images and custom thumbnails to RecurPost storage (the default). Send false, 0 or the form string "false" to keep your own URLs instead; they must then stay reachable until every post using them has been published.

params.name: alt_text
params.description: Alternative text per image, in image_url order; a single string applies to the first image. At most 1000 characters each. Saved on the Facebook, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Threads and Bluesky tabs; Instagram does not take alt text here.

params.name: fb_image_url

params.description: Facebook pages to mention, at most 10: page ids from /api/mention_search, as a list of ids or of {page_id, name} objects. Write each page in the text as @<page id>; the publisher turns it into the page's mention on Facebook pages.

params.name: fb_is_ai_generated
params.description: Label the Facebook post as made with AI. On a reel (fb_post_type=reel) Facebook shows its AI label on the reel; on an image post every image on the Facebook tab is labelled as an AI-generated photo, declared by you. Use fb_ai_images to label only some images or to give the provenance type.

params.name: fb_ai_images
params.description: Images to label as AI-generated photos on Facebook, named by the original URLs given in image_url (or fb_image_url when Facebook has its own images). A JSON array of URL strings, or of objects with image_url and provenance_type: EXPLICIT (declared by you, the default), EXPLICIT_AI_EDIT (edited with AI), C2PA (content credentials in the file), IPTC (IPTC AI metadata in the file) or INVISIBLE_WATERMARK. Labels the Facebook tab on its own, without fb_is_ai_generated. A URL that is not one of the post's Facebook images, or any other provenance type, answers 400.

params.name: ln_document
params.description: Public URL of a document to post as a LinkedIn document (carousel) post: PDF, PPT, PPTX, DOC or DOCX, detected from the file bytes, not the file name. The file is downloaded and stored on RecurPost storage and the LinkedIn tab becomes a document post. A file of another type is left as given and ignored by the publisher. Google Drive share links are resolved.

params.name: ln_document_title
params.description: Title shown on the LinkedIn document. Defaults to the file name without its extension.

params.name: ln_thumb
params.description: Custom cover image URL for the video on LinkedIn. Ignored when the post has no video_url.

params.name: in_post_type
params.description: Instagram post type. Case-insensitive; an unknown value keeps feed. A reel needs a video_url.

params.description: Whether a reel also appears in the profile feed. Only read when in_post_type is reel.

params.name: in_reel_tags
params.description: Usernames to tag on a reel, as a JSON array or a comma-separated string. Only saved when the post has a video_url.

params.name: in_collaborators
params.description: Instagram usernames invited as collaborators, as a JSON array or a comma-separated string. At most 3.

params.name: in_trial_reel
params.description: Publish the reel as a trial reel, shown to non-followers first. manual: you decide in Instagram when to share it with followers; performance: Instagram shares it when it does well. Reels only.

params.name: in_product_tags
params.description: Instagram product tags on images: objects with account_id (encrypted, the account whose catalog holds the product), product_id (from /api/instagram_products), image (1-based position in image_url), x and y (0 to 1, default 0.5), and optionally product_name and product_image.

params.name: in_reel_product_tags
params.description: Products tagged on a reel: objects with account_id (encrypted) and product_id (from /api/instagram_products), optionally product_name and image_url. Reels only.

params.name: in_is_ai_generated

params.description: Pin title. The destination link of the pin is url or the first link in the text.

params.name: pi_ai_modified
params.description: Pinterest AI disclosure: the Pin's content was generated or modified with AI.

params.name: pi_synthetic_performer
params.description: Pinterest AI disclosure: a person shown or heard in the Pin is AI-generated.

params.name: gbp_cta

params.name: gbp_offer_title
params.description: Offer title; offer fields are used when gbp_cta is Offer.

params.name: gbp_offer_end_date
params.description: Offer end, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

params.name: gbp_offer_coupon_code

params.description: Link to redeem the offer.

params.name: yt_user_tags

endpoints.summary: Save a new draft, or replace the content and accounts of an existing one.

params.name: id
params.description: Encrypted social account ids from /api/social_account_list: an array, a JSON array string, a comma-separated string or one id. At most 50, all in the workspace.

params.name: message
params.description: Post text for every network. Required unless image_url or video_url is sent. \r\n is normalised to \n. Links in it are detected for the link preview and, on Pinterest, for the pin's destination.
params.example: Check out our summer sale! https://example.com/summer-sale

params.name: draft_id
params.description: Encrypted id of an existing draft (from /api/draft_list or an earlier /api/draft_save). When sent, that draft is replaced in place instead of a new one being created.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Workspace to act in. Defaults to your default workspace. Get ids from /api/workspace_list.

params.name: schedule_date_time
params.description: Intended publish time, recorded on the draft only; the post is not scheduled until /api/draft_schedule. A bare YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (also with T, seconds optional) is wall-clock time in each account's timezone; a value with an offset or Z is one moment, converted to each account's timezone. A value that does not parse is ignored and a past time is not refused. When omitted the app records the save time. The misspelt shedule_date_time is also read.

params.name: url
params.description: Link to share with the post. On a text post the page's title, description and image are fetched and saved as the link preview; when omitted, the first link found in message is used instead. When a Pinterest account is targeted, on an image or video post, it becomes the pin's destination link. http:// is prepended when the scheme is missing. The host must be a public address.

params.name: image_url
params.description: Image URLs in display order: an array, a JSON array string, or one URL string (repeat image_url[] in form encoding). At most 20. Each must be a public http or https URL; it is downloaded and stored in the workspace owner's RecurPost media storage unless host_images_on_recurpost is off. A URL already in the owner's RecurPost storage (for example from /api/media_list) is used as it is, without a download. Together with video_url it makes a mixed post (images and the video in one carousel on Instagram and Threads; every other network posts what it takes by default).

params.name: video_url
params.description: A public mp4 or mov URL (Google Drive share links are resolved to the download URL). The file is downloaded and stored on RecurPost storage during the call, whatever host_images_on_recurpost says; a URL already in the owner's RecurPost storage skips the download. Needs a paid plan of the workspace owner.

params.name: media_order
params.description: The order of a mixed post's media as a list of the original URLs given in image_url and video_url. Media left out of the list follow, video first. Only read when both images and a video are sent. Any URL not in image_url / video_url answers 400.

params.name: host_images_on_recurpost
params.description: Copy images and custom covers (fb_thumb and the others) to RecurPost storage, the default. false, 0, no or off keeps your own image URLs instead: they are only checked to be public and must stay reachable until every post using them has been published. Videos and the LinkedIn document are always stored.

params.name: alt_text
params.description: Alternative text per shared image, in image_url order: an array, a JSON array string, or one string for the first image. At most 1000 characters each; blank entries are skipped. Saved on the Facebook, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Threads and Bluesky tabs that post the shared images; Instagram, Google Business, YouTube and TikTok take no alt text.

params.name: first_comment
params.description: First comment posted right after the post, commonly hashtags. Used on Facebook, LinkedIn and Instagram unless that network's own first comment is given.

params.name: fb_message
params.description: Text for Facebook accounts when it should differ from message. A value equal to message is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: tw_message
params.description: Text for Twitter/X accounts when it should differ from message. A value equal to message is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: ln_message
params.description: Text for LinkedIn accounts when it should differ from message. A value equal to message is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: in_message
params.description: Text for Instagram accounts when it should differ from message. A value equal to message is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: gmb_message
params.description: Text for Google Business accounts when it should differ from message. A value equal to message is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: pi_message
params.description: Text for Pinterest accounts when it should differ from message. A value equal to message is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: yt_message

params.name: tk_message

params.name: th_message

Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. A blank value counts as not sent.

Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. A blank value counts as not sent.

params.name: bs_video_url
params.description: A video for Bluesky accounts instead of the shared media, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with bs_image_url. A blank value counts as not sent.

params.name: bs_alt_text
params.description: Alternative text for the bs_image_url images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared alt_text is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

params.name: fb_post_type
params.description: Facebook post type. Case-insensitive; an unknown value keeps feed.

params.name: fb_thumb
params.description: Custom cover image for Facebook's video. Public image URL; copied to RecurPost storage unless host_images_on_recurpost is off. Ignored when Facebook posts no video.

params.name: fb_first_comment
params.description: Facebook first comment; overrides first_comment on Facebook.

params.name: fb_mentions
params.description: Facebook pages to mention, up to 10: page ids from /api/mention_search, as an array (or JSON array string, or comma-separated string) of ids or of objects with page_id and name. Write @<page id> in the text where each mention goes; with a name the stored text reads @<name>, the way the composer writes a picked mention. Saved as page mentions on the Facebook tab. An id that is not all digits answers 400.

params.name: fb_background_id
params.description: Facebook text background, from /api/facebook_backgrounds (letters, digits, underscore or dash, up to 64 characters). Only on a post whose Facebook tab has no images and no video; otherwise 400.

params.name: fb_is_ai_generated
params.description: Label the Facebook post as made with AI. Only 1 (or true) switches it on. On a reel Facebook shows its AI label; on an image post every image on the Facebook tab is labelled. Use fb_ai_images to label only some images or to give the provenance type.

params.name: fb_ai_images
params.description: Images to label as AI-generated photos on Facebook, named by the original URLs given in image_url (or fb_image_url when Facebook has its own images): an array of URL strings, or of objects with image_url and provenance_type. provenance_type defaults to EXPLICIT and takes any type Facebook's photo API knows, for example EXPLICIT, EXPLICIT_AI_EDIT, C2PA, IPTC, INVISIBLE_WATERMARK or NONE (case-insensitive). A URL that is not one of the post's Facebook images, or an unknown type, answers 400.

params.name: tw_made_with_ai
params.description: Label the post as made with AI on Twitter/X. Only 1 (or true) switches it on.

params.name: twitter_thread
params.description: Follow-up tweets posted as a thread under the main tweet on Twitter/X accounts: an array (or JSON array string) of objects, each with message and optionally image_url (up to 4) or video_url (one, not both). At most 25 items; each needs a message, an image or a video. Media is hosted like the main post's and a thread video needs the paid plan too. Each item counts as a post in the owner's daily limit when an X account is targeted. Other networks ignore it.

params.name: ln_document
params.description: Public URL of a document for a LinkedIn document (carousel) post: PDF, PPT, PPTX, DOC or DOCX, detected from the file itself, not its name; any other type answers 415. The file is downloaded and stored on RecurPost storage and the LinkedIn tab becomes a document post. Google Drive share links are resolved.

params.name: ln_document_title
params.description: Title shown on the LinkedIn document. Defaults to the file name without its extension.

params.name: ln_thumb
params.description: Custom cover image for LinkedIn's video, hosted like fb_thumb. Ignored when LinkedIn posts no video.

params.name: ln_first_comment
params.description: LinkedIn first comment; overrides first_comment on LinkedIn.

params.name: in_post_type
params.description: Instagram post type. Case-insensitive; an unknown value keeps feed. A reel needs a video.

params.name: in_reel_share_in_feed
params.description: Whether a reel also appears in the profile feed. Only no switches it off; read on reels only.

params.name: in_thumb
params.description: Custom cover image for an Instagram reel, hosted like fb_thumb. Only applied when in_post_type is reel and Instagram posts a video.

params.name: in_first_comment
params.description: Instagram first comment; overrides first_comment on Instagram.

params.name: in_location_id
params.description: Instagram place id to tag the post with (letters, digits or underscore, up to 64 characters). Take id and name from /api/instagram_locations; in_location_name is required with it.

params.name: in_location_name
params.description: Name of the place in in_location_id, required with it.

params.name: in_location_city
params.description: City of the tagged place, as returned by /api/instagram_locations.

params.name: in_location_country
params.description: Country of the tagged place, as returned by /api/instagram_locations.

params.name: in_image_tags
params.description: People to tag on images: an array (or JSON array string) of objects with username (leading @ optional), x and y (fractions of the image width and height, 0 to 1) and image (1-based position in Instagram's images, default 1). A malformed entry or one pointing past the last image answers 400.

params.name: in_reel_tags
params.description: Usernames to tag on a reel, as an array, a JSON array string or a comma-separated string. Needs a video on Instagram's tab; answers 400 without one.

params.name: in_collaborators
params.description: Instagram usernames invited as collaborators, as an array, a JSON array string or a comma-separated string. At most 3; more answer 400.

params.name: in_audio_id
params.description: Music for an Instagram reel: a track id from /api/instagram_audio_search. Needs in_post_type reel, a video and in_audio_account_id; sent on any other post it answers 400.

params.name: in_audio_account_id
params.description: Encrypted id of the Instagram account the audio search ran for, from /api/social_account_list. Required with in_audio_id; must be an Instagram account of this workspace (404 otherwise).

params.name: in_audio_type
params.description: Kind of track, as the search returned it.

params.name: in_audio_title
params.description: Track title from the search, stored for display.

params.name: in_audio_artist
params.description: Artist from the search, stored for display.

params.name: in_audio_duration_ms
params.description: Track length in milliseconds from the search, a whole number; 0 when omitted.

params.name: in_audio_volume
params.description: Volume of the added track, 0 to 100.

params.name: in_video_volume
params.description: Volume of the video's own sound under the track, 0 to 100; 0 mutes it.

params.name: in_trial_reel
params.description: Publish the reel as an Instagram trial reel (shown to non-followers first): manual leaves sharing to everyone up to you, performance lets Instagram share it when it does well. Reels only; on another post type, or with another value, it answers 400.

params.name: in_product_tags
params.description: Shopping tags on images: an array (or JSON array string) of objects with account_id (encrypted Instagram account of this workspace), product_id (from /api/instagram_products), image (1-based position in Instagram's images, default 1), x and y (0 to 1, default 0.5) and optional product_name and product_image for display.

params.name: in_reel_product_tags
params.description: Shopping tags on a reel: an array (or JSON array string) of objects with account_id (encrypted Instagram account of this workspace), product_id (from /api/instagram_products) and optional product_name and image_url for display. Needs in_post_type reel; on another post type it answers 400.

params.name: in_is_ai_generated
params.description: Label the Instagram post as AI-generated. Only 1 (or true) switches it on.

params.name: pi_title
params.description: Pin title. The destination link of the pin is url or the first link in the text.
params.example: Summer Sale - Best Deals of the Season

params.name: pi_ai_modified
params.description: Pinterest AI disclosure: the Pin's content was generated or modified with AI. Only 1 (or true) switches it on.

params.name: pi_synthetic_performer
params.description: Pinterest AI disclosure: a person shown or heard in the Pin is AI-generated. Only 1 (or true) switches it on.

params.name: gbp_cta
params.description: Call-to-action button on the Google Business post. Case-insensitive. An unknown value or None saves no button. On a link post with no button given, Learn more pointing at the link is set automatically.

params.name: gbp_cta_url
params.description: Link the button opens. With gbp_cta=Offer and no gbp_redeem_offer_link, this value doubles as the redeem link.

params.name: gbp_offer_title
params.description: Offer title; the offer fields are used when gbp_cta is Offer.

params.name: gbp_offer_start_date
params.description: Offer start, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. Stored as sent without a check; a value that is not a date makes the offer fail on Google.

params.name: gbp_offer_end_date
params.description: Offer end, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, after the start. Stored as sent without a check.

params.name: gbp_offer_coupon_code
params.description: Coupon code shown on the offer.

params.name: gbp_offer_terms
params.description: Terms and conditions of the offer.

params.name: gbp_redeem_offer_link
params.description: Link to redeem the offer.

params.name: yt_title
params.description: Video title. YouTube needs a video; message or yt_message is the description.

params.name: yt_category
params.description: Category name, matched exactly against the list. An unknown or missing name falls back to the default category of the workspace owner's YouTube settings.

params.name: yt_privacy_status
params.description: Video privacy, lower-cased and stored as given, so use one of the listed values. The YouTube options (category, tags, thumbnail, made for kids, licence, embedding, languages, recording date, AI label) are saved together with a privacy status: left out, it defaults to public when one of yt_license, yt_embeddable, yt_default_language, yt_default_audio_language, yt_recording_date, yt_contains_synthetic_media=1 or yt_playlists is sent; with only the older options (yt_category, yt_user_tags, yt_thumb, yt_video_made_for_kids) and no privacy status, no options are stored and YouTube's defaults apply, as on the Zapier-era endpoint.

params.name: yt_user_tags
params.description: Video tags, comma-separated.

params.name: yt_thumb
params.description: Custom thumbnail for the YouTube video, hosted like fb_thumb. Ignored when YouTube posts no video.

params.name: yt_video_made_for_kids
params.description: Whether the video is made for kids. Only yes switches it on.

params.name: yt_license
params.description: Video licence. Any other value answers 400.

params.name: yt_embeddable
params.description: Whether other sites may embed the video. 0, no or false switches it off.

params.name: yt_default_language
params.description: Language of the title and description, a BCP-47 code such as en or hi. Stored as sent.

params.name: yt_default_audio_language
params.description: Language spoken in the video, a BCP-47 code. Stored as sent.

params.name: yt_recording_date
params.description: Date the video was recorded, YYYY-MM-DD; another form answers 400.

params.name: yt_contains_synthetic_media
params.description: Tell viewers the video contains realistic content altered or generated with AI. Only 1 (or true) switches it on.

params.name: tk_privacy_status
params.description: Who can watch the TikTok video. Case-insensitive, spaces or underscores (Public to Everyone or PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE); any other value is saved as Public to Everyone. The TikTok options are saved together with a privacy status: left out, it defaults to Public to Everyone when tk_auto_add_music, tk_thumb, tk_thumb_timestamp or tk_is_aigc=1 is sent; with only the older switches and no privacy status, no options are stored, as on the Zapier-era endpoint. /api/tiktok_options lists what the account allows.

params.name: tk_allow_comments
params.description: Allow comments on the TikTok video. Only no switches it off.

params.name: tk_allow_duet
params.description: Allow duets. Only no switches it off.

params.name: tk_allow_stitches
params.description: Allow stitches. Only no switches it off.

params.name: tk_promote_own_brand
params.description: 1 marks the video as promoting your own brand (TikTok's content disclosure).

params.name: tk_promote_other_brand
params.description: 1 marks the video as branded content for a third party.

params.name: tk_auto_add_music
params.description: 1 lets TikTok add music to a photo post.

params.name: tk_thumb
params.description: Custom cover image for TikTok's video, hosted like fb_thumb. Ignored when TikTok posts no video.

params.name: tk_thumb_timestamp
params.description: Frame of the video to use as cover, in milliseconds from the start; a whole number, otherwise 400.

params.name: tk_is_aigc
params.description: Add TikTok's AI-generated content label to the video. Only 1 (or true) switches it on.

params.name: bs_thumb
params.description: Custom cover image for Bluesky's video, hosted like fb_thumb. Ignored when Bluesky posts no video.

endpoints.title: Schedule Draft
endpoints.summary: Turn a draft into a scheduled post at the given time, keeping its id.

params.name: draft_id
params.description: Encrypted draft id from /api/draft_save or /api/draft_list.

params.name: schedule_date_time
params.description: Publish time. YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (also with T, seconds optional) is wall-clock time in each account's timezone; a value with an offset or Z is one exact moment.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Workspace to act in. Defaults to your default workspace. Get ids from /api/workspace_list.

endpoints.title: Delete Draft
endpoints.summary: Delete a draft and every account row it holds.

params.name: draft_id
params.description: Encrypted draft id from /api/draft_save or /api/draft_list.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Workspace to act in. Defaults to your default workspace. Get ids from /api/workspace_list.

endpoints.title: Feed List
endpoints.summary: List the RSS feeds of the workspace, or of one library.

params.name: library_id
params.description: Encrypted library id from /api/library_list. Only that library's feeds are returned.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Workspace to act in. Defaults to your default workspace. Get ids from /api/workspace_list.

endpoints.title: Create Feed
endpoints.summary: Attach an RSS feed to a library and fetch its current articles.

params.name: url
params.description: Public http or https address of the RSS or Atom feed, or of a page that links to one. YouTube addresses are refused.

params.name: library_id
params.description: Encrypted id of the library the articles go into, from /api/library_list.

params.name: message_template
params.description: Post text built for each article, at most 5000 characters, with {|||name|||} placeholders (see above). Left out or blank, each article is posted as its link alone, with the preview the network builds from the page.

params.name: auto_approve
params.description: true adds articles to the library without review, including the ones fetched now; false (default) leaves them waiting in /api/feed_items.

params.name: top_of_queue
params.description: true places approved articles at the front of the library's queue so they publish next. Default false.

params.name: host_images
params.description: true stores the feed's Host images setting, as the web's "Host Images on RecurPost?" box. It copies images that a feed maps into a post's Image(s) to RecurPost storage; the API maps no image field, so posts made from articles are link posts whose preview image stays the article's own image URL, as on the web when no image is mapped. Default false.

params.name: live_date
params.description: YYYY-MM-DD or blank. Posts made from the feed stay drafts and start publishing on this date.

params.name: expire_date
params.description: YYYY-MM-DD or blank, on or after live_date. Posts made from the feed stop recurring after this date.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Workspace to act in. Defaults to your default workspace. Get ids from /api/workspace_list.

endpoints.title: Feed Pause
endpoints.summary: Pause a feed of a library.

params.name: id
params.description: Encrypted feed id from /api/feed_list or /api/feed_create.

params.name: library_id
params.description: Encrypted id of the library the feed is attached to.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Workspace to act in. Defaults to your default workspace. Get ids from /api/workspace_list.

endpoints.title: Feed Resume
endpoints.summary: Resume a paused feed of a library.

params.name: id
params.description: Encrypted feed id from /api/feed_list or /api/feed_create.

params.name: library_id
params.description: Encrypted id of the library the feed is attached to.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Workspace to act in. Defaults to your default workspace. Get ids from /api/workspace_list.

endpoints.title: Feed Delete
endpoints.summary: Delete a feed from a library.

params.name: id
params.description: Encrypted feed id from /api/feed_list or /api/feed_create.

params.name: library_id
params.description: Encrypted id of the library the feed is attached to.

params.name: confirm
params.description: Must be true (also accepted: 1, yes, on).

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Workspace to act in. Defaults to your default workspace. Get ids from /api/workspace_list.

endpoints.title: Update Feed
endpoints.summary: Change a feed's settings in one library, or move it to another library.

params.name: id
params.description: Encrypted feed id from /api/feed_list.

params.name: library_id
params.description: Encrypted id of the library the feed currently fills.

params.name: new_library_id
params.description: Encrypted id of another library of the workspace to move the feed into. Refused when that library already has a feed with the same address.

params.name: auto_approve
params.description: true adds new articles to the library without review; false leaves them waiting in /api/feed_items. A value that is not a boolean counts as not sent.

params.name: top_of_queue
params.description: true places approved articles at the front of the library's queue. A value that is not a boolean counts as not sent.

params.name: host_images
params.description: true stores the feed's Host images setting, as the web's "Host Images on RecurPost?" box. It copies images that a feed maps into a post's Image(s) to RecurPost storage; the API maps no image field, so posts made from articles are link posts whose preview image stays the article's own image URL, as on the web when no image is mapped. A value that is not a boolean counts as not sent.

params.name: live_date
params.description: YYYY-MM-DD from which posts made from the feed publish; blank clears it.

params.name: expire_date
