endpoints.title: Add Content to Library
endpoints.summary: Add a recurring post to a content library.

params.name: id
params.description: Encrypted library id from /api/library_list. Exactly one.

params.name: message
params.description: Post text. \r\n is normalised to \n. The first link in it is used for the link preview when url is omitted.
params.example: Check out our latest product! https://example.com/product

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Workspace to act in. Defaults to your default workspace. Get ids from /api/workspace_list.

params.name: is_top_of_queue
params.description: 1 posts this content next on every account the library's schedules cover. Any other value means 0.

params.name: content_livedate
params.description: First day the post may go out, YYYY-MM-DD; kept as a draft until then. A datetime such as 2026-11-01T00:00:00+05:30 keeps its date part (the first ten characters); any other value answers 400. Blank means active at once.

params.name: content_expiredate
params.description: Last day the post may go out, YYYY-MM-DD; a datetime keeps its date part. Must be on or after content_livedate when both are sent; any other value answers 400. Blank means it never expires.

params.name: url
params.description: Link to share with the post. On a text post the page's title, description and image are fetched and saved as the link preview; when omitted, the first link found in message is used instead. On an image or video post the link is not saved (library posts carry no Pinterest destination link). http:// is prepended when the scheme is missing. The host must be a public address.

params.name: image_url
params.description: Image URLs, in display order. Send a JSON array (or repeat image_url[] in form encoding); a single string is accepted as a one-item list. At most 20 images. Each URL must be a publicly reachable http or https URL and answer an image content type. URLs already on RecurPost storage (for example from /api/media_list) are used as they are; every other URL is copied to RecurPost storage unless host_images_on_recurpost is off. With video_url as well, a Bearer or Basic caller gets one mixed post (images and the video, ordered by media_order; a network that cannot mix posts what it posts by default); a caller with the key in the body gets the video only and image_url is ignored, as before.

params.name: video_url
params.description: A public mp4 or mov URL (Google Drive share links are accepted and resolved to the download URL). The file is downloaded and stored on RecurPost storage, so the call takes as long as the download; a URL already on RecurPost storage skips the download. Needs a paid plan of the workspace owner.

params.name: media_order
params.description: The order of a mixed post's media as a list of the original URLs given in image_url and video_url. Media left out of the list follow, video first. Only read when images and a video are sent together by a Bearer or Basic caller (see image_url). Any URL not in image_url / video_url answers 400.

params.name: host_images_on_recurpost
params.description: Copy images and custom thumbnails to RecurPost storage (the default). Send false, 0 or the form string "false" to keep your own URLs instead; they must then stay reachable until every post using them has been published.

params.name: alt_text
params.description: Alternative text per image, in image_url order; a single string applies to the first image. At most 1000 characters each. Saved on the Facebook, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Threads and Bluesky tabs; Instagram does not take alt text here.

params.name: fb_image_url
params.description: Images for Facebook accounts instead of image_url, same rules and hosting as image_url. At most 15 images on Facebook. A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. Cannot be combined with fb_video_url.

params.name: fb_video_url
params.description: A video for Facebook accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with fb_image_url.

params.name: fb_alt_text
params.description: Alternative text for the fb_image_url images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared alt_text is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

params.name: tw_image_url
params.description: Images for Twitter/X accounts instead of image_url, same rules and hosting as image_url. At most 4 images on Twitter/X. A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. Cannot be combined with tw_video_url.

params.name: tw_video_url
params.description: A video for Twitter/X accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with tw_image_url.

params.name: tw_alt_text
params.description: Alternative text for the tw_image_url images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared alt_text is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

params.name: ln_image_url
params.description: Images for LinkedIn accounts instead of image_url, same rules and hosting as image_url. At most 20 images on LinkedIn. A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. Cannot be combined with ln_video_url.

params.name: ln_video_url
params.description: A video for LinkedIn accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with ln_image_url.

params.name: ln_alt_text
params.description: Alternative text for the ln_image_url images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared alt_text is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

params.name: in_image_url
params.description: Images for Instagram accounts instead of image_url, same rules and hosting as image_url. At most 10 media in all, images and video together on Instagram. A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. May be combined with in_video_url into a carousel; in_media_order sets the order.

params.name: in_video_url
params.description: A video for Instagram accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. May be combined with in_image_url into a carousel.

params.name: in_media_order
params.description: The order of Instagram's own media as a list of the URLs given in in_image_url and in_video_url. Media left out of the list follow, video first. Only read when both are sent. Any other URL answers 400.

params.name: gmb_image_url
params.description: Images for Google Business accounts instead of image_url, same rules and hosting as image_url. At most 1 image on Google Business. A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. Cannot be combined with gmb_video_url.

params.name: gmb_video_url
params.description: A video for Google Business accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with gmb_image_url.

params.name: pi_image_url
params.description: Images for Pinterest accounts instead of image_url, same rules and hosting as image_url. At most 1 image on Pinterest. A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. Cannot be combined with pi_video_url.

params.name: pi_video_url
params.description: A video for Pinterest accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with pi_image_url.

params.name: pi_alt_text
params.description: Alternative text for the pi_image_url images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared alt_text is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

params.name: yt_video_url
params.description: A video for YouTube accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. YouTube takes a video only, so there is no yt_image_url.

params.name: tk_image_url
params.description: Images for TikTok accounts instead of image_url, same rules and hosting as image_url. At most 10 images on TikTok. A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. Cannot be combined with tk_video_url.

params.name: tk_video_url
params.description: A video for TikTok accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with tk_image_url.

params.name: th_image_url
params.description: Images for Threads accounts instead of image_url, same rules and hosting as image_url. At most 20 media in all, images and video together on Threads. A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. May be combined with th_video_url into a carousel; th_media_order sets the order.

params.name: th_video_url
params.description: A video for Threads accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. May be combined with th_image_url into a carousel.

params.name: th_media_order
params.description: The order of Threads's own media as a list of the URLs given in th_image_url and th_video_url. Media left out of the list follow, video first. Only read when both are sent. Any other URL answers 400.

params.name: th_alt_text
params.description: Alternative text for the th_image_url images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared alt_text is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

params.name: bs_image_url
params.description: Images for Bluesky accounts instead of image_url, same rules and hosting as image_url. At most 4 images on Bluesky. A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. Cannot be combined with bs_video_url.

params.name: bs_video_url
params.description: A video for Bluesky accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with bs_image_url.

params.name: bs_alt_text
params.description: Alternative text for the bs_image_url images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared alt_text is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

params.name: fb_message
params.description: Text for Facebook accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: tw_message
params.description: Text for Twitter/X accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: tw_made_with_ai
params.description: Label the post as made with AI on Twitter/X. X shows the label on the post.

params.name: twitter_thread
params.description: Follow-up tweets saved with the library post and posted as a thread under the main tweet on Twitter/X accounts each time it publishes. A JSON array of objects, each with message and optionally image_url (up to 4) or video_url (one, not both). At most 25 items; each item needs a message, an image or a video. Media is hosted like the main post's. Other networks ignore it.

params.name: ln_message
params.description: Text for LinkedIn accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: in_message
params.description: Text for Instagram accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: gmb_message
params.description: Text for Google Business accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: pi_message
params.description: Text for Pinterest accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: yt_message
params.description: Text for YouTube accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview. On YouTube this is the video description.

params.name: tk_message
params.description: Text for TikTok accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: th_message
params.description: Text for Threads accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: bs_message
params.description: Text for Bluesky accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: first_comment
params.description: First comment posted right after the post, commonly hashtags. Applied on Facebook Pages, LinkedIn and Instagram feed posts unless a network-specific first comment is given.

params.name: fb_first_comment
params.description: Facebook first comment; overrides first_comment on Facebook.

params.name: ln_first_comment
params.description: LinkedIn first comment; overrides first_comment on LinkedIn.

params.name: in_first_comment
params.description: Instagram first comment (feed posts only); overrides first_comment on Instagram.

params.name: fb_post_type
params.description: Facebook post type. Case-insensitive; an unknown value keeps feed.

params.name: fb_thumb
params.description: Custom cover image URL for the video on Facebook. Public image URL; copied to RecurPost storage unless host_images_on_recurpost is off. Ignored when the post has no video_url.

params.name: fb_is_ai_generated
params.description: Label the Facebook post as made with AI. On a reel (fb_post_type=reel) Facebook shows its AI label on the reel; on an image post every image on the Facebook tab is labelled as an AI-generated photo, declared by you. Use fb_ai_images to label only some images or to give the provenance type.

params.name: fb_ai_images
params.description: Images to label as AI-generated photos on Facebook, named by the original URLs given in image_url (or fb_image_url when Facebook has its own images). A JSON array of URL strings, or of objects with image_url and provenance_type: EXPLICIT (declared by you, the default), EXPLICIT_AI_EDIT (edited with AI), C2PA (content credentials in the file), IPTC (IPTC AI metadata in the file) or INVISIBLE_WATERMARK. Labels the Facebook tab on its own, without fb_is_ai_generated. A URL that is not one of the post's Facebook images, or any other provenance type, answers 400.

params.name: ln_document
params.description: Public URL of a document to post as a LinkedIn document (carousel) post: PDF, PPT, PPTX, DOC or DOCX, detected from the file bytes, not the file name. The file is downloaded and stored on RecurPost storage and the LinkedIn tab becomes a document post. A file of another type is left as given and ignored by the publisher. Google Drive share links are resolved.

params.name: ln_document_title
params.description: Title shown on the LinkedIn document. Defaults to the file name without its extension.

params.name: ln_thumb
params.description: Custom cover image URL for the video on LinkedIn. Ignored when the post has no video_url.

params.name: in_post_type
params.description: Instagram post type. Case-insensitive; an unknown value keeps feed. A reel needs a video_url.

params.name: in_reel_share_in_feed
params.description: Whether a reel also appears in the profile feed. Only read when in_post_type is reel.

params.name: in_thumb
params.description: Custom cover image URL for an Instagram reel. Only applied when in_post_type is reel and the post has a video_url; copied to RecurPost storage because Meta fetches it at publish time.

params.name: in_location_id
params.description: Instagram place id to tag the post with. Take id and name from /api/instagram_locations.

params.name: in_location_name
params.description: Name of the place in in_location_id.

params.name: in_location_city
params.description: City of the tagged place, as returned by /api/instagram_locations.

params.name: in_location_country
params.description: Country of the tagged place, as returned by /api/instagram_locations.

params.name: in_image_tags
params.description: People to tag on feed images. A JSON array of objects with username, x and y (fractions of the image width and height between 0 and 1) and image (1-based position in image_url, default 1). The leading @ is optional.

params.name: in_reel_tags
params.description: Usernames to tag on a reel, as a JSON array or a comma-separated string. Only saved when the post has a video_url.

params.name: in_collaborators
params.description: Instagram usernames invited as collaborators, as a JSON array or a comma-separated string. At most 3.

params.name: in_trial_reel
params.description: Publish the reel as a trial reel, shown to non-followers first. manual: you decide in Instagram when to share it with followers; performance: Instagram shares it when it does well. Reels only.

params.name: in_product_tags
params.description: Instagram product tags on images: objects with account_id (encrypted, the account whose catalog holds the product), product_id (from /api/instagram_products), image (1-based position in image_url), x and y (0 to 1, default 0.5), and optionally product_name and product_image.

params.name: in_reel_product_tags
params.description: Products tagged on a reel: objects with account_id (encrypted) and product_id (from /api/instagram_products), optionally product_name and image_url. Reels only.

params.name: in_is_ai_generated
params.description: Label the Instagram post as AI-generated. Instagram shows its AI label on the post.

params.name: pi_title
params.description: Pin title. The destination link of the pin is url or the first link in the text.
params.example: Summer Sale - Best Deals of the Season

params.name: pi_ai_modified
params.description: Pinterest AI disclosure: the Pin's content was generated or modified with AI.

params.name: pi_synthetic_performer
params.description: Pinterest AI disclosure: a person shown or heard in the Pin is AI-generated.

params.name: gbp_cta
params.description: Call-to-action button on the Google Business post. Case-insensitive. An unknown value or None saves no button. On a link post with no CTA given, Learn more pointing at the link is set automatically.

params.name: gbp_cta_url
params.description: Link the button opens. Not used for Call now. With gbp_cta=Offer and no gbp_redeem_offer_link, this value doubles as the redeem link.

params.name: gbp_offer_title
params.description: Offer title; offer fields are used when gbp_cta is Offer.

params.name: gbp_offer_start_date
params.description: Offer start, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

params.name: gbp_offer_end_date
params.description: Offer end, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

params.name: gbp_offer_coupon_code
params.description: Coupon code shown on the offer.

params.name: gbp_offer_terms
params.description: Terms and conditions of the offer.

params.name: gbp_redeem_offer_link
params.description: Link to redeem the offer.

params.name: yt_title
params.description: Video title. YouTube needs a video_url; message or yt_message is the description.

params.name: yt_category
params.description: Category name, matched exactly against the list. An unknown or missing name falls back to the default category of the workspace owner's YouTube settings (Entertainment when none is set).

params.name: yt_privacy_status
params.description: Video privacy. Lower-cased and stored as given; use one of the listed values. When it is left out but one of yt_license, yt_embeddable, yt_default_language, yt_default_audio_language, yt_recording_date or yt_contains_synthetic_media is sent, public is saved.

params.name: yt_user_tags
params.description: Video tags, comma-separated.

params.name: yt_thumb
params.description: Custom thumbnail URL for the YouTube video. Public image URL; copied to RecurPost storage unless host_images_on_recurpost is off.

params.name: yt_video_made_for_kids
params.description: Whether the video is made for kids. Only yes switches it on.

params.name: yt_contains_synthetic_media
params.description: Tell viewers the video contains realistic content that was altered or generated with AI. YouTube shows a label on the video.

params.name: yt_license
params.description: Video license: youtube (standard YouTube license) or creativeCommon. Any other value answers 400.

params.name: yt_embeddable
params.description: Whether the video may be embedded on other sites. 0, no or false switches it off; anything else keeps it on.

params.name: yt_default_language
params.description: Language of the video's title and description, as a language code such as en. Saved as given.

params.name: yt_default_audio_language
params.description: Language spoken in the video, as a language code such as en-US. Saved as given.

params.name: yt_recording_date
params.description: Date the video was recorded, YYYY-MM-DD. Any other format answers 400.

params.name: tk_privacy_status
params.description: Who can watch the TikTok video. Case-insensitive, spaces or underscores. Any other value is saved as Public to Everyone; omitted leaves it unset, unless tk_auto_add_music, tk_thumb, tk_thumb_timestamp or tk_is_aigc is sent, which saves the default. /api/tiktok_options lists what the account allows.

params.name: tk_allow_comments
params.description: Allow comments on the TikTok video. Only no switches it off.

params.name: tk_allow_duet
params.description: Allow duets. Only no switches it off.

params.name: tk_allow_stitches
params.description: Allow stitches. Only no switches it off.

params.name: tk_promote_own_brand
params.description: Set to 1 to mark the video as promoting your own brand (TikTok's content disclosure).

params.name: tk_promote_other_brand
params.description: Set to 1 to mark the video as branded content for a third party.

params.name: tk_is_aigc
params.description: Add TikTok's AI-generated content label to the video.

params.name: tk_thumb
params.description: Custom cover image URL for the TikTok video. Public image URL; copied to RecurPost storage unless host_images_on_recurpost is off. Ignored when TikTok has no video.

params.name: tk_thumb_timestamp
params.description: Frame of the video TikTok uses as the cover, in milliseconds from the start. A value that is not a whole number answers 400.

params.name: tk_auto_add_music
params.description: Set to 1 to let TikTok add music to the post.

params.name: bs_thumb
params.description: Custom cover image URL for the video on Bluesky. Public image URL; copied to RecurPost storage unless host_images_on_recurpost is off. Ignored when Bluesky has no video.

params.name: fb_mentions
params.description: Facebook pages to mention, at most 10: page ids from /api/mention_search, as a list of ids or of {page_id, name} objects. Write each page in the text as @<page id>; the publisher turns it into the page's mention on Facebook pages.

params.name: fb_background_id
params.description: Facebook text background for a post without image_url or video_url: an id from /api/facebook_backgrounds (letters, digits, underscore or dash, up to 64 characters). Applied on Facebook pages only.

endpoints.title: Update Library Content
endpoints.summary: Change some fields of a library post; fields left out keep their values.

params.name: library_id
params.description: Encrypted id of the library the post belongs to (active or as a draft), from /api/library_list.

params.name: id
params.description: Encrypted library post id from /api/library_content_list.

params.name: message
params.description: New post text; left out, the stored text stays. \r\n is normalised to \n.
params.example: Updated: our latest product is now 20% off! https://example.com/product

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Workspace to act in. Defaults to your default workspace. Get ids from /api/workspace_list.

params.name: is_top_of_queue
params.description: Read but without effect on an update: the app's edit ignores it. Use /api/library_content_order_move to move the post.

params.name: content_livedate
params.description: First day the post may go out, YYYY-MM-DD; kept as a draft until then. A datetime such as 2026-11-01T00:00:00+05:30 keeps its date part (the first ten characters); any other value answers 400. Left out, the stored date stays; blank clears it.

params.name: content_expiredate
params.description: Last day the post may go out, YYYY-MM-DD; a datetime keeps its date part. Must be on or after content_livedate when both are sent; any other value answers 400. Left out, the stored date stays; blank clears it.

params.name: url
params.description: Link to share with the post. On a text post the page's title, description and image are fetched and saved as the link preview; when omitted, the first link found in message is used instead. On an image or video post the link is not saved (library posts carry no Pinterest destination link). http:// is prepended when the scheme is missing. The host must be a public address.

params.name: image_url
params.description: Image URLs, in display order. Send a JSON array (or repeat image_url[] in form encoding); a single string is accepted as a one-item list. At most 20 images. Each URL must be a publicly reachable http or https URL and answer an image content type. URLs already on RecurPost storage (for example from /api/media_list) are used as they are; every other URL is copied to RecurPost storage unless host_images_on_recurpost is off. With video_url as well, a Bearer or Basic caller gets one mixed post (images and the video, ordered by media_order; a network that cannot mix posts what it posts by default); a caller with the key in the body gets the video only and image_url is ignored, as before.

params.name: video_url
params.description: A public mp4 or mov URL (Google Drive share links are accepted and resolved to the download URL). The file is downloaded and stored on RecurPost storage, so the call takes as long as the download; a URL already on RecurPost storage skips the download. Needs a paid plan of the workspace owner.

params.name: media_order
params.description: The order of a mixed post's media as a list of the original URLs given in image_url and video_url. Media left out of the list follow, video first. Only read when images and a video are sent together by a Bearer or Basic caller (see image_url). Any URL not in image_url / video_url answers 400.

params.name: host_images_on_recurpost
params.description: Copy images and custom thumbnails to RecurPost storage (the default). Send false, 0 or the form string "false" to keep your own URLs instead; they must then stay reachable until every post using them has been published.

params.name: alt_text
params.description: Alternative text per image, in image_url order; a single string applies to the first image. At most 1000 characters each. Saved on the Facebook, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Threads and Bluesky tabs; Instagram does not take alt text here.

params.name: fb_image_url
params.description: Images for Facebook accounts instead of image_url, same rules and hosting as image_url. At most 15 images on Facebook. A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. Cannot be combined with fb_video_url.

params.name: fb_video_url
params.description: A video for Facebook accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with fb_image_url.

params.name: fb_alt_text
params.description: Alternative text for the fb_image_url images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared alt_text is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

params.name: tw_image_url
params.description: Images for Twitter/X accounts instead of image_url, same rules and hosting as image_url. At most 4 images on Twitter/X. A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. Cannot be combined with tw_video_url.

params.name: tw_video_url
params.description: A video for Twitter/X accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with tw_image_url.

params.name: tw_alt_text
params.description: Alternative text for the tw_image_url images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared alt_text is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

params.name: ln_image_url
params.description: Images for LinkedIn accounts instead of image_url, same rules and hosting as image_url. At most 20 images on LinkedIn. A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. Cannot be combined with ln_video_url.

params.name: ln_video_url
params.description: A video for LinkedIn accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with ln_image_url.

params.name: ln_alt_text
params.description: Alternative text for the ln_image_url images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared alt_text is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

params.name: in_image_url
params.description: Images for Instagram accounts instead of image_url, same rules and hosting as image_url. At most 10 media in all, images and video together on Instagram. A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. May be combined with in_video_url into a carousel; in_media_order sets the order.

params.name: in_video_url
params.description: A video for Instagram accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. May be combined with in_image_url into a carousel.

params.name: in_media_order
params.description: The order of Instagram's own media as a list of the URLs given in in_image_url and in_video_url. Media left out of the list follow, video first. Only read when both are sent. Any other URL answers 400.

params.name: gmb_image_url
params.description: Images for Google Business accounts instead of image_url, same rules and hosting as image_url. At most 1 image on Google Business. A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. Cannot be combined with gmb_video_url.

params.name: gmb_video_url
params.description: A video for Google Business accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with gmb_image_url.

params.name: pi_image_url
params.description: Images for Pinterest accounts instead of image_url, same rules and hosting as image_url. At most 1 image on Pinterest. A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. Cannot be combined with pi_video_url.

params.name: pi_video_url
params.description: A video for Pinterest accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with pi_image_url.

params.name: pi_alt_text
params.description: Alternative text for the pi_image_url images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared alt_text is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

params.name: yt_video_url
params.description: A video for YouTube accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. YouTube takes a video only, so there is no yt_image_url.

params.name: tk_image_url
params.description: Images for TikTok accounts instead of image_url, same rules and hosting as image_url. At most 10 images on TikTok. A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. Cannot be combined with tk_video_url.

params.name: tk_video_url
params.description: A video for TikTok accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with tk_image_url.

params.name: th_image_url
params.description: Images for Threads accounts instead of image_url, same rules and hosting as image_url. At most 20 media in all, images and video together on Threads. A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. May be combined with th_video_url into a carousel; th_media_order sets the order.

params.name: th_video_url
params.description: A video for Threads accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. May be combined with th_image_url into a carousel.

params.name: th_media_order
params.description: The order of Threads's own media as a list of the URLs given in th_image_url and th_video_url. Media left out of the list follow, video first. Only read when both are sent. Any other URL answers 400.

params.name: th_alt_text
params.description: Alternative text for the th_image_url images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared alt_text is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

params.name: bs_image_url
params.description: Images for Bluesky accounts instead of image_url, same rules and hosting as image_url. At most 4 images on Bluesky. A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. Cannot be combined with bs_video_url.

params.name: bs_video_url
params.description: A video for Bluesky accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). A blank value counts as not sent. Otherwise it replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with bs_image_url.

params.name: bs_alt_text
params.description: Alternative text for the bs_image_url images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared alt_text is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

params.name: fb_message
params.description: Text for Facebook accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: tw_message
params.description: Text for Twitter/X accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: tw_made_with_ai
params.description: Label the post as made with AI on Twitter/X. X shows the label on the post.

params.name: twitter_thread
params.description: Follow-up tweets saved with the library post and posted as a thread under the main tweet on Twitter/X accounts each time it publishes. A JSON array of objects, each with message and optionally image_url (up to 4) or video_url (one, not both). At most 25 items; each item needs a message, an image or a video. Media is hosted like the main post's. Other networks ignore it.

params.name: ln_message
params.description: Text for LinkedIn accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: in_message
params.description: Text for Instagram accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: gmb_message
params.description: Text for Google Business accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: pi_message
params.description: Text for Pinterest accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: yt_message
params.description: Text for YouTube accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview. On YouTube this is the video description.

params.name: tk_message
params.description: Text for TikTok accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: th_message
params.description: Text for Threads accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: bs_message
params.description: Text for Bluesky accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: first_comment
params.description: First comment posted right after the post, commonly hashtags. Applied on Facebook Pages, LinkedIn and Instagram feed posts unless a network-specific first comment is given.

params.name: fb_first_comment
params.description: Facebook first comment; overrides first_comment on Facebook.

params.name: fb_mentions
params.description: Facebook pages to mention, at most 10: page ids from /api/mention_search, as a list of ids or of {page_id, name} objects. Write each page in the text as @<page id>; the publisher turns it into the page's mention on Facebook pages.

params.name: fb_background_id
params.description: Facebook text background for a post without image_url or video_url: an id from /api/facebook_backgrounds (letters, digits, underscore or dash, up to 64 characters). Applied on Facebook pages only.

params.name: ln_first_comment
params.description: LinkedIn first comment; overrides first_comment on LinkedIn.

params.name: in_first_comment
params.description: Instagram first comment (feed posts only); overrides first_comment on Instagram.

params.name: fb_post_type
params.description: Facebook post type. Case-insensitive; an unknown value keeps feed.

params.name: fb_thumb
params.description: Custom cover image URL for the video on Facebook. Public image URL; copied to RecurPost storage unless host_images_on_recurpost is off. Ignored when the post has no video_url.

params.name: fb_is_ai_generated
params.description: Label the Facebook post as made with AI. On a reel (fb_post_type=reel) Facebook shows its AI label on the reel; on an image post every image on the Facebook tab is labelled as an AI-generated photo, declared by you. Use fb_ai_images to label only some images or to give the provenance type.

params.name: fb_ai_images
params.description: Images to label as AI-generated photos on Facebook, named by the original URLs given in image_url (or fb_image_url when Facebook has its own images). A JSON array of URL strings, or of objects with image_url and provenance_type: EXPLICIT (declared by you, the default), EXPLICIT_AI_EDIT (edited with AI), C2PA (content credentials in the file), IPTC (IPTC AI metadata in the file) or INVISIBLE_WATERMARK. Labels the Facebook tab on its own, without fb_is_ai_generated. A URL that is not one of the post's Facebook images, or any other provenance type, answers 400.

params.name: ln_document
params.description: Public URL of a document to post as a LinkedIn document (carousel) post: PDF, PPT, PPTX, DOC or DOCX, detected from the file bytes, not the file name. The file is downloaded and stored on RecurPost storage and the LinkedIn tab becomes a document post. A file of another type is left as given and ignored by the publisher. Google Drive share links are resolved.

params.name: ln_document_title
params.description: Title shown on the LinkedIn document. Defaults to the file name without its extension.

params.name: ln_thumb
params.description: Custom cover image URL for the video on LinkedIn. Ignored when the post has no video_url.

params.name: in_post_type
params.description: Instagram post type. Case-insensitive; an unknown value keeps feed. A reel needs a video_url.

params.name: in_reel_share_in_feed
params.description: Whether a reel also appears in the profile feed. Only read when in_post_type is reel.

params.name: in_thumb
params.description: Custom cover image URL for an Instagram reel. Only applied when in_post_type is reel and the post has a video_url; copied to RecurPost storage because Meta fetches it at publish time.

params.name: in_location_id
params.description: Instagram place id to tag the post with. Take id and name from /api/instagram_locations.

params.name: in_location_name
params.description: Name of the place in in_location_id.

params.name: in_location_city
params.description: City of the tagged place, as returned by /api/instagram_locations.

params.name: in_location_country
params.description: Country of the tagged place, as returned by /api/instagram_locations.

params.name: in_image_tags
params.description: People to tag on feed images. A JSON array of objects with username, x and y (fractions of the image width and height between 0 and 1) and image (1-based position in image_url, default 1). The leading @ is optional.

params.name: in_reel_tags
params.description: Usernames to tag on a reel, as a JSON array or a comma-separated string. Only saved when the post has a video_url.

params.name: in_collaborators
params.description: Instagram usernames invited as collaborators, as a JSON array or a comma-separated string. At most 3.

params.name: in_trial_reel
params.description: Publish the reel as a trial reel, shown to non-followers first. manual: you decide in Instagram when to share it with followers; performance: Instagram shares it when it does well. Reels only.

params.name: in_product_tags
params.description: Instagram product tags on images: objects with account_id (encrypted, the account whose catalog holds the product), product_id (from /api/instagram_products), image (1-based position in image_url), x and y (0 to 1, default 0.5), and optionally product_name and product_image.

params.name: in_reel_product_tags
params.description: Products tagged on a reel: objects with account_id (encrypted) and product_id (from /api/instagram_products), optionally product_name and image_url. Reels only.

params.name: in_is_ai_generated
params.description: Label the Instagram post as AI-generated. Instagram shows its AI label on the post.

params.name: pi_title
params.description: Pin title. The destination link of the pin is url or the first link in the text.
params.example: Summer Sale - Best Deals of the Season

params.name: pi_ai_modified
params.description: Pinterest AI disclosure: the Pin's content was generated or modified with AI.

params.name: pi_synthetic_performer

endpoints.title: Library Content Search
endpoints.summary: Find active library posts whose text, link title, variation or network version contains a phrase.

params.name: search_text
params.description: Phrase to look for. Leading and trailing spaces are trimmed; blank is a 400.

params.name: library_id
params.description: Encrypted library id from /api/library_list to search in. Omit to search every library of the workspace.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, from 1. A value that is not a whole number or is below 1 answers 400.

params.name: per_page

params.description: Workspace to act in. Defaults to your default workspace. Get ids from /api/workspace_list.

params.name: schedule_date_time
params.description: When to publish; leave out to publish now. A value with an offset or Z (2026-10-20T09:30:00+05:30) is one exact moment, converted to each account's timezone. A bare YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (also with T, seconds optional) is wall-clock time in each account's own timezone (the workspace owner's for an account without one), so accounts in different zones publish at the same local time. Must be in the future for every account. The misspelt legacy name shedule_date_time is still accepted. The date must be a real calendar day and the time a real clock time: a value such as 2026-13-40 10:00:00, 2027-02-30 10:00:00 or 25:00 is refused with 400, never rolled over into another day.

params.name: url
params.description: Link to share with the post. On a text post the page's title, description and image are fetched and saved as the link preview; when omitted, the first link found in message is used instead. When a Pinterest account is targeted, on an image or video post, it becomes the pin's destination link. http:// is prepended when the scheme is missing. The host must be a public address.

params.name: image_url
params.description: Image URLs in display order: an array, a JSON array string, or one URL string (repeat image_url[] in form encoding). At most 20. Each must be a public http or https URL; it is downloaded and stored in the workspace owner's RecurPost media storage unless host_images_on_recurpost is off. A URL already in the owner's RecurPost storage (for example from /api/media_list) is used as it is, without a download. Together with video_url it makes a mixed post (images and the video in one carousel on Instagram and Threads; every other network posts what it takes by default). Exception: a key-in-body (Zapier-era) call that sends both keeps the video only, as that endpoint always did; Bearer and Basic callers get the mixed post.

params.name: video_url
params.description: A public mp4 or mov URL (Google Drive share links are resolved to the download URL). The file is downloaded and stored on RecurPost storage during the call, whatever host_images_on_recurpost says; a URL already in the owner's RecurPost storage skips the download. Needs a paid plan of the workspace owner. A URL that answers 404 or 410 is refused with 422 media_failed (could not be downloaded), not as a wrong format.

params.name: media_order
params.description: The order of a mixed post's media as a list of the original URLs given in image_url and video_url. Media left out of the list follow, video first. Only read when both images and a video are sent. Any URL not in image_url / video_url answers 400.

params.name: host_images_on_recurpost
params.description: Copy images and custom covers (fb_thumb and the others) to RecurPost storage, the default. false, 0, no or off keeps your own image URLs instead: they are only checked to be public and must stay reachable until every post using them has been published. Videos and the LinkedIn document are always stored.

params.name: alt_text
params.description: Alternative text per shared image, in image_url order: an array, a JSON array string, or one string for the first image. At most 1000 characters each; blank entries are skipped. Saved on the Facebook, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Threads and Bluesky tabs that post the shared images; Instagram, Google Business, YouTube and TikTok take no alt text.

params.name: first_comment
params.description: First comment posted right after the post, commonly hashtags. Used on Facebook, LinkedIn and Instagram unless that network's own first comment is given.

params.name: fb_message
params.description: Text for Facebook accounts when it should differ from message. A value equal to message is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: tw_message
params.description: Text for Twitter/X accounts when it should differ from message. A value equal to message is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: ln_message
params.description: Text for LinkedIn accounts when it should differ from message. A value equal to message is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: in_message
params.description: Text for Instagram accounts when it should differ from message. A value equal to message is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: gmb_message
params.description: Text for Google Business accounts when it should differ from message. A value equal to message is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: pi_message
params.description: Text for Pinterest accounts when it should differ from message. A value equal to message is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: yt_message
params.description: Text for YouTube accounts when it should differ from message. A value equal to message is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview. On YouTube this is the video description.

params.name: tk_message
params.description: Text for TikTok accounts when it should differ from message. A value equal to message is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: th_message
params.description: Text for Threads accounts when it should differ from message. A value equal to message is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: bs_message
params.description: Text for Bluesky accounts when it should differ from message. A value equal to message is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: fb_image_url
params.description: Images for Facebook accounts instead of the shared media, same forms, rules and hosting as image_url. At most 15 images on Facebook. Cannot be combined with fb_video_url. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. A blank value counts as not sent.

params.name: fb_video_url
params.description: A video for Facebook accounts instead of the shared media, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with fb_image_url. A blank value counts as not sent.

params.name: fb_alt_text
params.description: Alternative text for the fb_image_url images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared alt_text is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. A blank value counts as not sent.

params.name: ln_alt_text

params.name: yt_video_url
