params.name: fb_post_type
params.description: Facebook post type, case-insensitive: one of the listed values, or a list (an array or JSON array string) to post several types at once, as the composer does: ["feed", "story"], ["feed", "reel"], ["story", "reel"] or ["feed", "story", "reel"]. Each type becomes its own queue item on every Facebook page of the post (one row per type in post_status). An unknown value answers 400; a one-item list is the same as the single value.

params.name: fb_thumb
params.description: Custom cover image for Facebook's video. Public image URL; copied to RecurPost storage unless host_images_on_recurpost is off. Ignored when Facebook posts no video.

params.name: fb_first_comment
params.description: Facebook first comment; overrides first_comment on Facebook.

params.name: fb_mentions
params.description: Facebook pages to mention, up to 10: page ids from /api/mention_search, as an array (or JSON array string, or comma-separated string) of ids or of objects with page_id and name. Write @<page id> in the text where each mention goes; with a name the stored text reads @<name>, the way the composer writes a picked mention. Saved as page mentions on the Facebook tab. An id that is not all digits answers 400.

params.name: fb_background_id
params.description: Facebook text background, from /api/facebook_backgrounds (letters, digits, underscore or dash, up to 64 characters). Only on a post whose Facebook tab has no images and no video; otherwise 400.

params.name: fb_is_ai_generated
params.description: Label the Facebook post as made with AI. Only 1 (or true) switches it on. On a reel Facebook shows its AI label; on an image post every image on the Facebook tab is labelled. Use fb_ai_images to label only some images or to give the provenance type.

params.name: fb_ai_images
params.description: Images to label as AI-generated photos on Facebook, named by the original URLs given in image_url (or fb_image_url when Facebook has its own images): an array of URL strings, or of objects with image_url and provenance_type. provenance_type defaults to EXPLICIT and takes any type Facebook's photo API knows, for example EXPLICIT, EXPLICIT_AI_EDIT, C2PA, IPTC, INVISIBLE_WATERMARK or NONE (case-insensitive). A URL that is not one of the post's Facebook images, or an unknown type, answers 400.

params.name: tw_made_with_ai
params.description: Label the post as made with AI on Twitter/X. Only 1 (or true) switches it on.

params.name: twitter_thread
params.description: Follow-up tweets posted as a thread under the main tweet on Twitter/X accounts: an array (or JSON array string) of objects, each with message and optionally image_url (up to 4) or video_url (one, not both). At most 25 items; each needs a message, an image or a video. Media is hosted like the main post's and a thread video needs the paid plan too. Each item counts as a post in the owner's daily limit when an X account is targeted. Other networks ignore it.

params.name: ln_document
params.description: Public URL of a document for a LinkedIn document (carousel) post: PDF, PPT, PPTX, DOC or DOCX, detected from the file itself, not its name; any other type answers 415. The file is downloaded and stored on RecurPost storage and the LinkedIn tab becomes a document post. Google Drive share links are resolved.

params.name: ln_document_title
params.description: Title shown on the LinkedIn document. Defaults to the file name without its extension.

params.name: ln_thumb
params.description: Custom cover image for LinkedIn's video, hosted like fb_thumb. Ignored when LinkedIn posts no video.

params.name: ln_first_comment
params.description: LinkedIn first comment; overrides first_comment on LinkedIn.

params.name: in_post_type
params.description: Instagram post type, case-insensitive: one of the listed values, or the list ["feed", "story"] or ["story", "reel"] to post both, as the composer does (each type becomes its own queue item; the second goes out a minute after the first). Instagram does not take a reel together with a feed post, so ["feed", "reel"] answers 400, as does an unknown value. A reel needs a video; the reel options (in_thumb, in_reel_share_in_feed, in_trial_reel, in_audio_id, reel tags and products) apply whenever reel is one of the types.

params.name: in_reel_share_in_feed
params.description: Whether a reel also appears in the profile feed. Only no switches it off; read on reels only.

params.name: in_thumb
params.description: Custom cover image for an Instagram reel, hosted like fb_thumb. Only applied when in_post_type is or includes reel and Instagram posts a video.

params.name: in_first_comment
params.description: Instagram first comment; overrides first_comment on Instagram.

params.name: in_location_id
params.description: Instagram place id to tag the post with (letters, digits or underscore, up to 64 characters). Take id and name from /api/instagram_locations; in_location_name is required with it.

params.name: in_location_name
params.description: Name of the place in in_location_id, required with it.

params.name: in_location_city
params.description: City of the tagged place, as returned by /api/instagram_locations.

params.name: in_location_country
params.description: Country of the tagged place, as returned by /api/instagram_locations.

params.name: in_image_tags
params.description: People to tag on images: an array (or JSON array string) of objects with username (leading @ optional), x and y (fractions of the image width and height, 0 to 1) and image (1-based position in Instagram's images, default 1). A malformed entry or one pointing past the last image answers 400.

params.name: in_reel_tags
params.description: Usernames to tag on a reel, as an array, a JSON array string or a comma-separated string. Needs a video on Instagram's tab; answers 400 without one.

params.name: in_collaborators
params.description: Instagram usernames invited as collaborators, as an array, a JSON array string or a comma-separated string. At most 3; more answer 400.

params.name: in_audio_id
params.description: Music for an Instagram reel: a track id from /api/instagram_audio_search. Needs in_post_type reel, a video and in_audio_account_id; sent on any other post it answers 400.

params.name: in_audio_account_id
params.description: Encrypted id of the Instagram account the audio search ran for, from /api/social_account_list. Required with in_audio_id; must be an Instagram account of this workspace (404 otherwise).

params.name: in_audio_type
params.description: Kind of track, as the search returned it.

params.name: in_audio_title
params.description: Track title from the search, stored for display.

params.name: in_audio_artist
params.description: Artist from the search, stored for display.

params.name: in_audio_duration_ms
params.description: Track length in milliseconds from the search, a whole number; 0 when omitted.

params.name: in_audio_volume
params.description: Volume of the added track, 0 to 100.

params.name: in_video_volume
params.description: Volume of the video's own sound under the track, 0 to 100; 0 mutes it.

params.name: in_trial_reel
params.description: Publish the reel as an Instagram trial reel (shown to non-followers first): manual leaves sharing to everyone up to you, performance lets Instagram share it when it does well. Reels only; on another post type, or with another value, it answers 400.

params.name: in_product_tags
params.description: Shopping tags on images: an array (or JSON array string) of objects with account_id (encrypted Instagram account of this workspace), product_id (from /api/instagram_products), image (1-based position in Instagram's images, default 1), x and y (0 to 1, default 0.5) and optional product_name and product_image for display.

params.name: in_reel_product_tags
params.description: Shopping tags on a reel: an array (or JSON array string) of objects with account_id (encrypted Instagram account of this workspace), product_id (from /api/instagram_products) and optional product_name and image_url for display. Needs in_post_type reel; on another post type it answers 400.

params.name: in_is_ai_generated
params.description: Label the Instagram post as AI-generated. Only 1 (or true) switches it on.

params.name: pi_title
params.description: Pin title. The destination link of the pin is url or the first link in the text.
params.example: Summer Sale - Best Deals of the Season

params.name: pi_ai_modified
params.description: Pinterest AI disclosure: the Pin's content was generated or modified with AI. Only 1 (or true) switches it on.

params.name: pi_synthetic_performer
params.description: Pinterest AI disclosure: a person shown or heard in the Pin is AI-generated. Only 1 (or true) switches it on.

params.name: gbp_cta
params.description: Call-to-action button on the Google Business post. Case-insensitive. An unknown value or None saves no button. On a link post with no button given, Learn more pointing at the link is set automatically.

params.name: gbp_cta_url
params.description: Link the button opens. With gbp_cta=Offer and no gbp_redeem_offer_link, this value doubles as the redeem link.

params.name: gbp_offer_title
params.description: Offer title; the offer fields are used when gbp_cta is Offer.

params.name: gbp_offer_start_date
params.description: Offer start, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. Stored as sent without a check; a value that is not a date makes the offer fail on Google.

params.name: gbp_offer_end_date
params.description: Offer end, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, after the start. Stored as sent without a check.

params.name: gbp_offer_coupon_code
params.description: Coupon code shown on the offer.

params.name: gbp_offer_terms
params.description: Terms and conditions of the offer.

params.name: gbp_redeem_offer_link
params.description: Link to redeem the offer.

params.name: yt_title
params.description: Video title. YouTube needs a video; message or yt_message is the description.

params.name: yt_category
params.description: Category name, matched exactly against the list. An unknown or missing name falls back to the default category of the workspace owner's YouTube settings.

params.name: yt_privacy_status
params.description: Video privacy, one of the listed values (case-insensitive); any other value answers 400. The YouTube options (category, tags, thumbnail, made for kids, licence, embedding, languages, recording date, AI label) are saved together with a privacy status: left out, it defaults to public when one of yt_license, yt_embeddable, yt_default_language, yt_default_audio_language, yt_recording_date, yt_contains_synthetic_media=1 or yt_playlists is sent; with only the older options (yt_category, yt_user_tags, yt_thumb, yt_video_made_for_kids) and no privacy status, no options are stored and YouTube's defaults apply, as on the Zapier-era endpoint.

params.name: yt_user_tags
params.description: Video tags, comma-separated.

params.name: yt_thumb
params.description: Custom thumbnail for the YouTube video, hosted like fb_thumb. Ignored when YouTube posts no video.

params.name: yt_video_made_for_kids
params.description: Whether the video is made for kids. Only yes switches it on.

params.name: yt_license
params.description: Video licence. Any other value answers 400.

params.name: yt_embeddable
params.description: Whether other sites may embed the video. 0, no or false switches it off.

params.name: yt_default_language
params.description: Language of the title and description, a BCP-47 code such as en or hi. Stored as sent.

params.name: yt_default_audio_language
params.description: Language spoken in the video, a BCP-47 code. Stored as sent.

params.name: yt_recording_date
params.description: Date the video was recorded, YYYY-MM-DD; another form answers 400.

params.name: yt_contains_synthetic_media
params.description: Tell viewers the video contains realistic content altered or generated with AI. Only 1 (or true) switches it on.

params.name: yt_playlists
params.description: Playlists to add the video to, one per YouTube account: an object (or JSON object string) of encrypted YouTube account id (one of the accounts in id) to playlist id (from /api/youtube_options). Playlist ids are YouTube's own. Only /api/post_content takes it.

params.name: tk_privacy_status
params.description: Who can watch the TikTok video. Case-insensitive, spaces or underscores (Public to Everyone or PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE); any other value answers 400 naming the allowed values (nothing is saved as Public in its place). The TikTok options are saved together with a privacy status: left out, it defaults to Public to Everyone when tk_auto_add_music, tk_thumb, tk_thumb_timestamp or tk_is_aigc=1 is sent; with only the older switches and no privacy status, no options are stored, as on the Zapier-era endpoint. /api/tiktok_options lists what the account allows.

params.name: tk_allow_comments
params.description: Allow comments on the TikTok video. Only no switches it off.

params.name: tk_allow_duet
params.description: Allow duets. Only no switches it off.

params.name: tk_allow_stitches
params.description: Allow stitches. Only no switches it off.

params.name: tk_promote_own_brand
params.description: 1 marks the video as promoting your own brand (TikTok's content disclosure).

params.name: tk_promote_other_brand
params.description: 1 marks the video as branded content for a third party.

params.name: tk_auto_add_music
params.description: 1 lets TikTok add music to a photo post.

params.name: tk_thumb
params.description: Custom cover image for TikTok's video, hosted like fb_thumb. Ignored when TikTok posts no video.

params.name: tk_thumb_timestamp
params.description: Frame of the video to use as cover, in milliseconds from the start; a whole number, otherwise 400.

params.name: tk_is_aigc
params.description: Add TikTok's AI-generated content label to the video. Only 1 (or true) switches it on.

params.name: bs_thumb
params.description: Custom cover image for Bluesky's video, hosted like fb_thumb. Ignored when Bluesky posts no video.

endpoints.title: Queue List
endpoints.summary: Queued items of the workspace in a date window, one per account and time.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Workspace to act in. Defaults to your default workspace. Get ids from /api/workspace_list.

params.name: account_id
params.description: Encrypted social account ids from /api/social_account_list: an array, a JSON array string, a comma-separated string or one id. At most 50. Only items on these accounts are returned.

params.name: library_id
params.description: Encrypted library ids from /api/library_list, in the same forms. At most 50. Only items coming from these libraries are returned.

params.name: from
params.description: First day of the window, YYYY-MM-DD in the owner's timezone. Defaults to today.

params.name: to
params.description: Last day of the window, YYYY-MM-DD in the owner's timezone, not before from. Defaults to 30 days after today, or to from when that lies further out.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Items per page, 1 to 50.

endpoints.title: Queue Item
endpoints.summary: One queued item by its id.

params.name: id
params.description: Encrypted queue item id from /api/queue_list or accounts[].queue_item_id of /api/post_status.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Workspace to act in. Defaults to your default workspace. Get ids from /api/workspace_list.

endpoints.title: Update Queue Item
endpoints.summary: Move a queued item to a new time, change the post behind it, or both.

params.name: id
params.description: Encrypted queue item id from /api/queue_list.

params.name: schedule_date_time
params.description: New time for this item, in the future. Required when no content field is sent. A value with an offset or Z (2026-10-25T09:30:00+05:30) is one exact moment; a bare YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (also with T, seconds optional) is read in the workspace owner's timezone. shedule_date_time is also read.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Workspace to act in. Defaults to your default workspace. Get ids from /api/workspace_list.

params.name: message
params.description: New shared text for every network of the post. Left out, the stored text stays. A network's own text (fb_message and the rest) wins over it for that network. \r\n is normalised to \n.
params.example: Check out our summer sale! https://example.com/summer-sale

params.name: url
params.description: Link to share with the post. On a text post the page's title, description and image are fetched and saved as the link preview; when omitted, the first link found in message is used instead. When a Pinterest account is targeted, on an image or video post, it becomes the pin's destination link. http:// is prepended when the scheme is missing. The host must be a public address.

params.name: image_url
params.description: Image URLs in display order: an array, a JSON array string, or one URL string (repeat image_url[] in form encoding). At most 20. Each must be a public http or https URL; it is downloaded and stored in the workspace owner's RecurPost media storage unless host_images_on_recurpost is off. A URL already in the owner's RecurPost storage (for example from /api/media_list) is used as it is, without a download. Together with video_url it makes a mixed post (images and the video in one carousel on Instagram and Threads; every other network posts what it takes by default).

params.name: video_url
params.description: A public mp4 or mov URL (Google Drive share links are resolved to the download URL). The file is downloaded and stored on RecurPost storage during the call, whatever host_images_on_recurpost says; a URL already in the owner's RecurPost storage skips the download. Needs a paid plan of the workspace owner.

params.name: media_order
params.description: The order of a mixed post's media as a list of the original URLs given in image_url and video_url. Media left out of the list follow, video first. Only read when both images and a video are sent. Any URL not in image_url / video_url answers 400.

params.name: host_images_on_recurpost
params.description: Copy images and custom covers (fb_thumb and the others) to RecurPost storage, the default. false, 0, no or off keeps your own image URLs instead: they are only checked to be public and must stay reachable until every post using them has been published. Videos and the LinkedIn document are always stored.

params.name: alt_text
params.description: Alternative text per shared image, in image_url order: an array, a JSON array string, or one string for the first image. At most 1000 characters each; blank entries are skipped. Saved on the Facebook, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Threads and Bluesky tabs that post the shared images; Instagram, Google Business, YouTube and TikTok take no alt text.

params.name: first_comment
params.description: First comment posted right after the post, commonly hashtags. Used on Facebook, LinkedIn and Instagram unless that network's own first comment is given.

params.name: fb_message
params.description: Text for Facebook accounts when it should differ from message. A value equal to message is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview. Sent blank, the network's own text is dropped and it posts message.

params.name: tw_message
params.description: Text for Twitter/X accounts when it should differ from message. A value equal to message is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview. Sent blank, the network's own text is dropped and it posts message.

params.name: ln_message
params.description: Text for LinkedIn accounts when it should differ from message. A value equal to message is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview. Sent blank, the network's own text is dropped and it posts message.

params.name: in_message
params.description: Text for Instagram accounts when it should differ from message. A value equal to message is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview. Sent blank, the network's own text is dropped and it posts message.

params.name: gmb_message
params.description: Text for Google Business accounts when it should differ from message. A value equal to message is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview. Sent blank, the network's own text is dropped and it posts message.

params.name: pi_message
params.description: Text for Pinterest accounts when it should differ from message. A value equal to message is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview. Sent blank, the network's own text is dropped and it posts message.

params.name: yt_message
params.description: Text for YouTube accounts when it should differ from message. A value equal to message is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview. On YouTube this is the video description. Sent blank, the network's own text is dropped and it posts message.

params.name: tk_message
params.description: Text for TikTok accounts when it should differ from message. A value equal to message is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview. Sent blank, the network's own text is dropped and it posts message.

params.name: th_message
params.description: Text for Threads accounts when it should differ from message. A value equal to message is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview. Sent blank, the network's own text is dropped and it posts message.

params.name: bs_message
params.description: Text for Bluesky accounts when it should differ from message. A value equal to message is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview. Sent blank, the network's own text is dropped and it posts message.

params.name: fb_image_url
params.description: Images for Facebook accounts instead of the shared media, same forms, rules and hosting as image_url. At most 15 images on Facebook. Cannot be combined with fb_video_url. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. A blank value counts as not sent.

params.name: fb_video_url
params.description: A video for Facebook accounts instead of the shared media, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with fb_image_url. A blank value counts as not sent.

params.name: fb_alt_text
params.description: Alternative text for the fb_image_url images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared alt_text is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

params.name: tw_image_url
params.description: Images for Twitter/X accounts instead of the shared media, same forms, rules and hosting as image_url. At most 4 images on Twitter/X. Cannot be combined with tw_video_url. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. A blank value counts as not sent.

params.name: tw_video_url
params.description: A video for Twitter/X accounts instead of the shared media, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with tw_image_url. A blank value counts as not sent.

params.name: tw_alt_text
params.description: Alternative text for the tw_image_url images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared alt_text is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

params.name: ln_image_url
params.description: Images for LinkedIn accounts instead of the shared media, same forms, rules and hosting as image_url. At most 20 images on LinkedIn. Cannot be combined with ln_video_url. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. A blank value counts as not sent.

params.name: ln_video_url
params.description: A video for LinkedIn accounts instead of the shared media, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with ln_image_url. A blank value counts as not sent.

params.name: ln_alt_text
params.description: Alternative text for the ln_image_url images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared alt_text is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

params.name: in_image_url
params.description: Images for Instagram accounts instead of the shared media, same forms, rules and hosting as image_url. At most 10 media in all, images and video together on Instagram. May be combined with in_video_url into a carousel; in_media_order sets the order. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. A blank value counts as not sent.

params.name: in_video_url
params.description: A video for Instagram accounts instead of the shared media, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. May be combined with in_image_url into a carousel. A blank value counts as not sent.

params.name: in_media_order
params.description: The order of Instagram's own media as a list of the URLs given in in_image_url and in_video_url. Media left out follow, video first. Only read when both are sent. Any other URL answers 400.

params.name: gmb_image_url
params.description: Images for Google Business accounts instead of the shared media, same forms, rules and hosting as image_url. At most 1 image on Google Business. Cannot be combined with gmb_video_url. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. A blank value counts as not sent.

params.name: gmb_video_url
params.description: A video for Google Business accounts instead of the shared media, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with gmb_image_url. A blank value counts as not sent.

params.name: pi_image_url
params.description: Images for Pinterest accounts instead of the shared media, same forms, rules and hosting as image_url. At most 1 image on Pinterest. Cannot be combined with pi_video_url. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. A blank value counts as not sent.

params.name: pi_video_url
params.description: A video for Pinterest accounts instead of the shared media, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with pi_image_url. A blank value counts as not sent.

params.name: pi_alt_text
params.description: Alternative text for the pi_image_url images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared alt_text is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

params.name: yt_video_url
params.description: A video for YouTube accounts instead of the shared media, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. YouTube takes a video only; yt_image_url answers 400. A blank value counts as not sent.

params.name: tk_image_url
params.description: Images for TikTok accounts instead of the shared media, same forms, rules and hosting as image_url. At most 10 images on TikTok. Cannot be combined with tk_video_url. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. A blank value counts as not sent.

params.name: tk_video_url
params.description: A video for TikTok accounts instead of the shared media, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with tk_image_url. A blank value counts as not sent.

params.name: th_image_url
params.description: Images for Threads accounts instead of the shared media, same forms, rules and hosting as image_url. At most 20 media in all, images and video together on Threads. May be combined with th_video_url into a carousel; th_media_order sets the order. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. A blank value counts as not sent.

params.name: th_video_url
params.description: A video for Threads accounts instead of the shared media, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. May be combined with th_image_url into a carousel. A blank value counts as not sent.

params.name: th_media_order
params.description: The order of Threads's own media as a list of the URLs given in th_image_url and th_video_url. Media left out follow, video first. Only read when both are sent. Any other URL answers 400.

params.name: th_alt_text
params.description: Alternative text for the th_image_url images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared alt_text is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

params.name: bs_image_url
params.description: Images for Bluesky accounts instead of the shared media, same forms, rules and hosting as image_url. At most 4 images on Bluesky. Cannot be combined with bs_video_url. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. A blank value counts as not sent.

params.name: bs_video_url
params.description: A video for Bluesky accounts instead of the shared media, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with bs_image_url. A blank value counts as not sent.

params.name: bs_alt_text
params.description: Alternative text for the bs_image_url images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared alt_text is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

params.name: fb_post_type
params.description: Facebook post type. Case-insensitive; an unknown value keeps feed.

params.name: fb_thumb
params.description: Custom cover image for Facebook's video. Public image URL; copied to RecurPost storage unless host_images_on_recurpost is off. Ignored when Facebook posts no video.

params.name: fb_first_comment
params.description: Facebook first comment; overrides first_comment on Facebook.

params.name: fb_mentions
params.description: Facebook pages to mention, up to 10: page ids from /api/mention_search, as an array (or JSON array string, or comma-separated string) of ids or of objects with page_id and name. Write @<page id> in the text where each mention goes; with a name the stored text reads @<name>, the way the composer writes a picked mention. Saved as page mentions on the Facebook tab. An id that is not all digits answers 400.

params.name: fb_background_id
params.description: Facebook text background, from /api/facebook_backgrounds (letters, digits, underscore or dash, up to 64 characters). Only on a post whose Facebook tab has no images and no video; otherwise 400.

params.name: fb_is_ai_generated
params.description: Label the Facebook post as made with AI. Only 1 (or true) switches it on. On a reel Facebook shows its AI label; on an image post every image on the Facebook tab is labelled. Use fb_ai_images to label only some images or to give the provenance type.

params.name: fb_ai_images
params.description: Images to label as AI-generated photos on Facebook, named by the original URLs given in image_url (or fb_image_url when Facebook has its own images): an array of URL strings, or of objects with image_url and provenance_type. provenance_type defaults to EXPLICIT and takes any type Facebook's photo API knows, for example EXPLICIT, EXPLICIT_AI_EDIT, C2PA, IPTC, INVISIBLE_WATERMARK or NONE (case-insensitive). A URL that is not one of the post's Facebook images, or an unknown type, answers 400.

params.name: tw_made_with_ai
params.description: Label the post as made with AI on Twitter/X. Only 1 (or true) switches it on.

params.name: twitter_thread
params.description: Follow-up tweets posted as a thread under the main tweet on Twitter/X accounts: an array (or JSON array string) of objects, each with message and optionally image_url (up to 4) or video_url (one, not both). At most 25 items; each needs a message, an image or a video. Media is hosted like the main post's and a thread video needs the paid plan too. Each item counts as a post in the owner's daily limit when an X account is targeted. Other networks ignore it.

params.name: ln_document
params.description: Public URL of a document for a LinkedIn document (carousel) post: PDF, PPT, PPTX, DOC or DOCX, detected from the file itself, not its name; any other type answers 415. The file is downloaded and stored on RecurPost storage and the LinkedIn tab becomes a document post. Google Drive share links are resolved.

params.name: ln_document_title
params.description: Title shown on the LinkedIn document. Defaults to the file name without its extension.

params.name: ln_thumb
params.description: Custom cover image for LinkedIn's video, hosted like fb_thumb. Ignored when LinkedIn posts no video.

params.name: ln_first_comment
params.description: LinkedIn first comment; overrides first_comment on LinkedIn.

params.name: in_post_type
params.description: Instagram post type. Case-insensitive; an unknown value keeps feed. A reel needs a video.

params.name: in_reel_share_in_feed
params.description: Whether a reel also appears in the profile feed. Only no switches it off; read on reels only.

params.name: in_thumb
params.description: Custom cover image for an Instagram reel, hosted like fb_thumb. Only applied when in_post_type is reel and Instagram posts a video.

params.name: in_first_comment
params.description: Instagram first comment; overrides first_comment on Instagram.

params.name: in_location_id
params.description: Instagram place id to tag the post with (letters, digits or underscore, up to 64 characters). Take id and name from /api/instagram_locations; in_location_name is required with it.

params.name: in_location_name
params.description: Name of the place in in_location_id, required with it.

params.name: in_location_city
params.description: City of the tagged place, as returned by /api/instagram_locations.

params.name: in_location_country
params.description: Country of the tagged place, as returned by /api/instagram_locations.

params.name: in_image_tags
params.description: People to tag on images: an array (or JSON array string) of objects with username (leading @ optional), x and y (fractions of the image width and height, 0 to 1) and image (1-based position in Instagram's images, default 1). A malformed entry or one pointing past the last image answers 400.

params.name: in_reel_tags
params.description: Usernames to tag on a reel, as an array, a JSON array string or a comma-separated string. Needs a video on Instagram's tab; answers 400 without one.

params.name: in_collaborators
params.description: Instagram usernames invited as collaborators, as an array, a JSON array string or a comma-separated string. At most 3; more answer 400.

params.name: in_audio_id
params.description: Music for an Instagram reel: a track id from /api/instagram_audio_search. Needs in_post_type reel, a video and in_audio_account_id; sent on any other post it answers 400.

params.name: in_audio_account_id
params.description: Encrypted id of the Instagram account the audio search ran for, from /api/social_account_list. Required with in_audio_id; must be an Instagram account of this workspace (404 otherwise).

params.name: in_audio_type
params.description: Kind of track, as the search returned it.

params.name: in_audio_title
params.description: Track title from the search, stored for display.

params.name: in_audio_artist
params.description: Artist from the search, stored for display.

params.name: in_audio_duration_ms
params.description: Track length in milliseconds from the search, a whole number; 0 when omitted.

params.name: in_audio_volume
params.description: Volume of the added track, 0 to 100.

params.name: in_video_volume
params.description: Volume of the video's own sound under the track, 0 to 100; 0 mutes it.

params.name: in_trial_reel
params.description: Publish the reel as an Instagram trial reel (shown to non-followers first): manual leaves sharing to everyone up to you, performance lets Instagram share it when it does well. Reels only; on another post type, or with another value, it answers 400.

params.name: in_product_tags
params.description: Shopping tags on images: an array (or JSON array string) of objects with account_id (encrypted Instagram account of this workspace), product_id (from /api/instagram_products), image (1-based position in Instagram's images, default 1), x and y (0 to 1, default 0.5) and optional product_name and product_image for display.

params.name: in_reel_product_tags
params.description: Shopping tags on a reel: an array (or JSON array string) of objects with account_id (encrypted Instagram account of this workspace), product_id (from /api/instagram_products) and optional product_name and image_url for display. Needs in_post_type reel; on another post type it answers 400.

params.name: in_is_ai_generated
params.description: Label the Instagram post as AI-generated. Only 1 (or true) switches it on.

params.name: pi_title
params.description: Pin title. The destination link of the pin is url or the first link in the text.
params.example: Summer Sale - Best Deals of the Season

params.name: pi_ai_modified
params.description: Pinterest AI disclosure: the Pin's content was generated or modified with AI. Only 1 (or true) switches it on.

params.name: pi_synthetic_performer
params.description: Pinterest AI disclosure: a person shown or heard in the Pin is AI-generated. Only 1 (or true) switches it on.

params.name: gbp_cta
params.description: Call-to-action button on the Google Business post. Case-insensitive. An unknown value or None saves no button. On a link post with no button given, Learn more pointing at the link is set automatically.

params.name: gbp_cta_url
params.description: Link the button opens. With gbp_cta=Offer and no gbp_redeem_offer_link, this value doubles as the redeem link.

params.name: gbp_offer_title
params.description: Offer title; the offer fields are used when gbp_cta is Offer.

params.name: gbp_offer_start_date
params.description: Offer start, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. Stored as sent without a check; a value that is not a date makes the offer fail on Google.

params.name: gbp_offer_end_date
params.description: Offer end, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, after the start. Stored as sent without a check.

params.name: gbp_offer_coupon_code
params.description: Coupon code shown on the offer.

params.name: gbp_offer_terms
params.description: Terms and conditions of the offer.

params.name: gbp_redeem_offer_link
params.description: Link to redeem the offer.

params.name: yt_title
params.description: Video title. YouTube needs a video; message or yt_message is the description.

params.name: yt_category
params.description: Category name, matched exactly against the list. An unknown or missing name falls back to the default category of the workspace owner's YouTube settings.

params.name: yt_privacy_status
params.description: Video privacy, lower-cased and stored as given, so use one of the listed values. The YouTube options (category, tags, thumbnail, made for kids, licence, embedding, languages, recording date, AI label) are saved together with a privacy status: left out, it defaults to public when one of yt_license, yt_embeddable, yt_default_language, yt_default_audio_language, yt_recording_date, yt_contains_synthetic_media=1 or yt_playlists is sent; with only the older options (yt_category, yt_user_tags, yt_thumb, yt_video_made_for_kids) and no privacy status, no options are stored and YouTube's defaults apply, as on the Zapier-era endpoint.

params.name: yt_user_tags
params.description: Video tags, comma-separated.

params.name: yt_thumb
params.description: Custom thumbnail for the YouTube video, hosted like fb_thumb. Ignored when YouTube posts no video.

params.name: yt_video_made_for_kids
params.description: Whether the video is made for kids. Only yes switches it on.

params.name: yt_license
params.description: Video licence. Any other value answers 400.

params.name: yt_embeddable
params.description: Whether other sites may embed the video. 0, no or false switches it off.

params.name: yt_default_language
params.description: Language of the title and description, a BCP-47 code such as en or hi. Stored as sent.

params.name: yt_default_audio_language
params.description: Language spoken in the video, a BCP-47 code. Stored as sent.

params.name: yt_recording_date
params.description: Date the video was recorded, YYYY-MM-DD; another form answers 400.

params.name: yt_contains_synthetic_media
params.description: Tell viewers the video contains realistic content altered or generated with AI. Only 1 (or true) switches it on.

params.name: tk_privacy_status
params.description: Who can watch the TikTok video. Case-insensitive, spaces or underscores (Public to Everyone or PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE); any other value is saved as Public to Everyone. The TikTok options are saved together with a privacy status: left out, it defaults to Public to Everyone when tk_auto_add_music, tk_thumb, tk_thumb_timestamp or tk_is_aigc=1 is sent; with only the older switches and no privacy status, no options are stored, as on the Zapier-era endpoint. /api/tiktok_options lists what the account allows.

params.name: tk_allow_comments
params.description: Allow comments on the TikTok video. Only no switches it off.

params.name: tk_allow_duet
params.description: Allow duets. Only no switches it off.

params.name: tk_allow_stitches
params.description: Allow stitches. Only no switches it off.

params.name: tk_promote_own_brand
params.description: 1 marks the video as promoting your own brand (TikTok's content disclosure).

params.name: tk_promote_other_brand
params.description: 1 marks the video as branded content for a third party.

params.name: tk_auto_add_music
params.description: 1 lets TikTok add music to a photo post.

params.name: tk_thumb
params.description: Custom cover image for TikTok's video, hosted like fb_thumb. Ignored when TikTok posts no video.

params.name: tk_thumb_timestamp
params.description: Frame of the video to use as cover, in milliseconds from the start; a whole number, otherwise 400.

params.name: tk_is_aigc
params.description: Add TikTok's AI-generated content label to the video. Only 1 (or true) switches it on.

params.name: bs_thumb
params.description: Custom cover image for Bluesky's video, hosted like fb_thumb. Ignored when Bluesky posts no video.

endpoints.title: Delete Queue Items
endpoints.summary: Remove one or several queued items.

params.name: id
params.description: Encrypted queue item ids: an array, a JSON array string, a comma-separated string or one id. At most 50.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Workspace to act in. Defaults to your default workspace. Get ids from /api/workspace_list.

endpoints.title: Reschedule Queue Items
endpoints.summary: Move queued items to another day, keeping each item's time of day.

params.name: to_date
params.description: Target day, YYYY-MM-DD in the workspace owner's timezone.

params.name: id
params.description: Encrypted queue item ids: an array, a JSON array string, a comma-separated string or one id. At most 50. Required when from_date is not sent; every id must still be queued.

params.name: from_date
params.description: Day to move, YYYY-MM-DD in the owner's timezone. Required when id is not sent; ignored when it is.

params.name: account_ids
params.description: With from_date: encrypted social account ids (an array, a JSON array string, a comma-separated string or one id; at most 50) to limit the move to those accounts.

params.name: library_id
params.description: With from_date: one encrypted library id to limit the move to items from that library.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Workspace to act in. Defaults to your default workspace. Get ids from /api/workspace_list.

endpoints.title: Publish Now
endpoints.summary: Publish queued items of one post right away.

params.name: id
params.description: Encrypted queue item ids of one post: an array, a JSON array string, a comma-separated string or one id. At most 50.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Workspace to act in. Defaults to your default workspace. Get ids from /api/workspace_list.

endpoints.title: Retry Failed Post
endpoints.summary: Retry a failed queue item now or at a new time.

params.name: id
params.description: Encrypted queue item id of the failed post.

params.name: schedule_date_time
params.description: Time to retry at, in the future. A value with an offset or Z is one exact moment; a bare YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (also with T, seconds optional) is read in the social account's timezone (the owner's when the account has none). Omit to retry now. shedule_date_time is also read.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Workspace to act in. Defaults to your default workspace. Get ids from /api/workspace_list.

endpoints.title: Calendar
endpoints.summary: The queue laid out by day, every day of the range present, empty days included.

params.name: workspace_ids

params.name: share_with_client

params.name: label_ids

Each entry is a URL string or {url, type} with type image or video; without a type, .mp4, .mov, .m4v and .webm count as video, everything else as image. Replaces the current media; an empty value clears it.
