endpoints.title: Workflow Post Create
endpoints.summary: Create a post card in a stage.

params.name: title
params.description: Card title.

params.name: stage_id
params.description: Encrypted id of the stage the post starts in, from columns[].stage_id of /api/workflow_board. Not a Client Review stage: a post reaches the client only through the hand-over (/api/workflow_card_advance), where the app checks accounts, schedule and media.

params.name: description
params.description: Description or caption draft.
params.example: Short teaser for the spring launch.

params.name: platforms
params.description: Platform keys (array, JSON-encoded array string or comma-separated): instagram, facebook, linkedin, twitter, google, pinterest, youtube, tiktok, threads, bluesky.

params.name: account_ids
params.description: Encrypted social account ids (array, JSON array string or comma-separated) the card will publish to. They must be the workspace owner's accounts (404 otherwise), and the app requires them to be attached to the card's workspace.

params.name: target_date
params.description: Target date in the owner's wall clock, YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

params.name: assignee_user_id
params.description: Encrypted user id from members[] of /api/workflow_board or /api/workflow_card; 0 or an empty string clears the assignee. It must be the owner or an active member of a board workspace (404 otherwise). A person who may not work the stage is not assigned; with no assignee the app may pick one for the stage by its own rules. Read assignee on the card.

params.name: share_with_client
params.description: Whether the card is shared with the client for approval. Defaults to the workflow setting for posts. Only the owner and members with Send posts to clients can set it; for anyone else it is ignored and the workflow setting applies. Read client_approval on the card to see what was kept.

params.name: label_ids
params.description: Encrypted label ids of the owner's labels (/api/label_list): an array, a JSON array string or a comma-separated list, at most 50.

params.name: media
params.description: Up to 10 attachments as publicly reachable http or https URLs: an array, a JSON array string, a comma-separated string, or one {url, type} object. Each entry is a URL string or {url, type} with type image or video; without a type, .mp4, .mov, .m4v and .webm count as video, everything else as image.

params.name: schedule
params.description: Draft schedule slots, one object per slot (an array or a JSON array string): {account_id, at} with at as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM (wall clock of that account's timezone), or {account_id, date, best_time: true} with date as YYYY-MM-DD to let RecurPost pick the best time that day. account_id is an encrypted account id of the owner. Only the owner, the Workspace Manager and members with Publish or schedule may set the schedule; from anyone else the app ignores it without an error. A slot in the past is refused.

params.name: image_url
params.description: Shared images for the per-network build, as on /api/post_content: a JSON array, a JSON array string or one URL. Sending it counts as a customisation field. Without it the card's image media is used. The images are fetched into the owner's storage and replace the card's media.

params.name: video_url
params.description: Shared video for the per-network build, as on /api/post_content (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Sending it counts as a customisation field. Without it the card's first video is used. The file is fetched into the owner's storage and becomes part of the card's media.

params.name: url
params.description: Link to share, as on /api/post_content. Counts as a customisation field.

params.name: host_images_on_recurpost
params.description: As on /api/post_content: false keeps your own image URLs instead of copying them to RecurPost storage. Counts as a customisation field.

params.name: alt_text
params.description: Alternative text per image, in image_url order; a single string applies to the first image. At most 1000 characters each. Saved on the Facebook, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Threads and Bluesky tabs; Instagram does not take alt text here.

params.name: fb_image_url
params.description: Images for Facebook accounts instead of image_url, same rules and hosting as image_url. At most 15 images on Facebook. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. Cannot be combined with fb_video_url.

params.name: fb_video_url
params.description: A video for Facebook accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with fb_image_url.

params.name: fb_alt_text
params.description: Alternative text for the fb_image_url images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared alt_text is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

params.name: tw_image_url
params.description: Images for Twitter/X accounts instead of image_url, same rules and hosting as image_url. At most 4 images on Twitter/X. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. Cannot be combined with tw_video_url.

params.name: tw_video_url
params.description: A video for Twitter/X accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with tw_image_url.

params.name: tw_alt_text
params.description: Alternative text for the tw_image_url images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared alt_text is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

params.name: ln_image_url
params.description: Images for LinkedIn accounts instead of image_url, same rules and hosting as image_url. At most 20 images on LinkedIn. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. Cannot be combined with ln_video_url.

params.name: ln_video_url
params.description: A video for LinkedIn accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with ln_image_url.

params.name: ln_alt_text
params.description: Alternative text for the ln_image_url images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared alt_text is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

params.name: in_image_url
params.description: Images for Instagram accounts instead of image_url, same rules and hosting as image_url. At most 10 media in all, images and video together on Instagram. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. May be combined with in_video_url into a carousel; in_media_order sets the order.

params.name: in_video_url
params.description: A video for Instagram accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. May be combined with in_image_url into a carousel.

params.name: in_media_order
params.description: The order of Instagram's own media as a list of the URLs given in in_image_url and in_video_url. Media left out of the list follow, video first. Only read when both are sent. Any other URL answers 400.

params.name: gmb_image_url
params.description: Images for Google Business accounts instead of image_url, same rules and hosting as image_url. At most 1 image on Google Business. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. Cannot be combined with gmb_video_url.

params.name: gmb_video_url
params.description: A video for Google Business accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with gmb_image_url.

params.name: pi_image_url
params.description: Images for Pinterest accounts instead of image_url, same rules and hosting as image_url. At most 1 image on Pinterest. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. Cannot be combined with pi_video_url.

params.name: pi_video_url
params.description: A video for Pinterest accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with pi_image_url.

params.name: pi_alt_text
params.description: Alternative text for the pi_image_url images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared alt_text is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

params.name: yt_video_url
params.description: A video for YouTube accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. YouTube takes a video only, so there is no yt_image_url.

params.name: tk_image_url
params.description: Images for TikTok accounts instead of image_url, same rules and hosting as image_url. At most 10 images on TikTok. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. Cannot be combined with tk_video_url.

params.name: tk_video_url
params.description: A video for TikTok accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with tk_image_url.

params.name: th_image_url
params.description: Images for Threads accounts instead of image_url, same rules and hosting as image_url. At most 20 media in all, images and video together on Threads. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. May be combined with th_video_url into a carousel; th_media_order sets the order.

params.name: th_video_url
params.description: A video for Threads accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. May be combined with th_image_url into a carousel.

params.name: th_media_order
params.description: The order of Threads's own media as a list of the URLs given in th_image_url and th_video_url. Media left out of the list follow, video first. Only read when both are sent. Any other URL answers 400.

params.name: th_alt_text
params.description: Alternative text for the th_image_url images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared alt_text is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

params.name: bs_image_url
params.description: Images for Bluesky accounts instead of image_url, same rules and hosting as image_url. At most 4 images on Bluesky. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. Cannot be combined with bs_video_url.

params.name: bs_video_url
params.description: A video for Bluesky accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with bs_image_url.

params.name: bs_alt_text
params.description: Alternative text for the bs_image_url images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared alt_text is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

params.name: fb_message
params.description: Text for Facebook accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: tw_message
params.description: Text for Twitter/X accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: tw_made_with_ai
params.description: Label the post as made with AI on Twitter/X. X shows the label on the post.

params.name: ln_message
params.description: Text for LinkedIn accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: in_message
params.description: Text for Instagram accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: gmb_message
params.description: Text for Google Business accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: pi_message
params.description: Text for Pinterest accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: yt_message
params.description: Text for YouTube accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview. On YouTube this is the video description.

params.name: tk_message
params.description: Text for TikTok accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: th_message
params.description: Text for Threads accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: bs_message
params.description: Text for Bluesky accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: first_comment
params.description: First comment posted right after the post, commonly hashtags. Applied on Facebook Pages, LinkedIn and Instagram feed posts unless a network-specific first comment is given.

params.name: fb_first_comment
params.description: Facebook first comment; overrides first_comment on Facebook.

params.name: ln_first_comment
params.description: LinkedIn first comment; overrides first_comment on LinkedIn.

params.name: in_first_comment
params.description: Instagram first comment (feed posts only); overrides first_comment on Instagram.

params.name: fb_post_type
params.description: Facebook post type. Case-insensitive; an unknown value keeps feed.

params.name: fb_thumb
params.description: Custom cover image URL for the video on Facebook. Public image URL; copied to RecurPost storage unless host_images_on_recurpost is off. Ignored when the post has no video_url.

params.name: fb_mentions
params.description: Facebook pages to mention, up to 10: page ids from /api/mention_search, as a JSON array of ids or of objects with page_id and name. Write @<page id> in the text where each mention should appear; the publisher turns it into the page's mention on Facebook Pages. An id that is not all digits answers 400.

params.name: fb_background_id
params.description: Facebook text background for a post without image_url or video_url: an id from /api/facebook_backgrounds (letters, digits, underscore or dash, up to 64 characters). Applied on Facebook pages only.

params.name: fb_is_ai_generated
params.description: Label the Facebook post as made with AI. On a reel (fb_post_type=reel) Facebook shows its AI label on the reel; on an image post every image on the Facebook tab is labelled as an AI-generated photo, declared by you. Use fb_ai_images to label only some images or to give the provenance type.

params.name: fb_ai_images
params.description: Images to label as AI-generated photos on Facebook, named by the original URLs given in image_url (or fb_image_url when Facebook has its own images). A JSON array of URL strings, or of objects with image_url and provenance_type: EXPLICIT (declared by you, the default), EXPLICIT_AI_EDIT (edited with AI), C2PA (content credentials in the file), IPTC (IPTC AI metadata in the file) or INVISIBLE_WATERMARK. Labels the Facebook tab on its own, without fb_is_ai_generated. A URL that is not one of the post's Facebook images, or any other provenance type, answers 400.

params.name: ln_document
params.description: Public URL of a document to post as a LinkedIn document (carousel) post: PDF, PPT, PPTX, DOC or DOCX, detected from the file bytes, not the file name. The file is downloaded and stored on RecurPost storage and the LinkedIn tab becomes a document post. A file of another type is left as given and ignored by the publisher. Google Drive share links are resolved.

params.name: ln_document_title
params.description: Title shown on the LinkedIn document. Defaults to the file name without its extension.

params.name: ln_thumb
params.description: Custom cover image URL for the video on LinkedIn. Ignored when the post has no video_url.

params.name: in_post_type
params.description: Instagram post type. Case-insensitive; an unknown value keeps feed. A reel needs a video_url.

params.name: in_reel_share_in_feed
params.description: Whether a reel also appears in the profile feed. Only read when in_post_type is reel.

params.name: in_thumb
params.description: Custom cover image URL for an Instagram reel. Only applied when in_post_type is reel and the post has a video_url; copied to RecurPost storage because Meta fetches it at publish time.

params.name: in_location_id
params.description: Instagram place id to tag the post with. Take id and name from /api/instagram_locations. in_location_name is required with it.

params.name: in_location_name
params.description: Name of the place in in_location_id, required with it.

params.name: in_location_city
params.description: City of the tagged place, as returned by /api/instagram_locations.

params.name: in_location_country
params.description: Country of the tagged place, as returned by /api/instagram_locations.

params.name: in_image_tags
params.description: People to tag on feed images. A JSON array of objects with username, x and y (fractions of the image width and height between 0 and 1) and image (1-based position in image_url, default 1). The leading @ is optional. Any entry missing a username, with coordinates outside 0..1 or pointing past the last image answers 400.

params.name: in_reel_tags
params.description: Usernames to tag on a reel, as a JSON array or a comma-separated string. Only saved when the post has a video_url; answers 400 without one.

params.name: in_collaborators
params.description: Instagram usernames invited as collaborators, as a JSON array or a comma-separated string. At most 3; more answer 400.

params.name: in_audio_id
params.description: Music for an Instagram reel: a track id from /api/instagram_audio_search. Needs in_post_type reel, a video_url and in_audio_account_id; ignored on feed and story posts.

params.name: in_audio_account_id
params.description: Encrypted id of the Instagram account the audio search ran for (the account_id in that answer). Required with in_audio_id.

params.name: in_audio_type
params.description: Kind of track, as the search returned it.

params.name: in_audio_title
params.description: Track title from the search, stored for display.

params.name: in_audio_artist
params.description: Artist from the search, stored for display.

params.name: in_audio_duration_ms
params.description: Track length in milliseconds from the search; 0 when omitted.

params.name: in_audio_volume
params.description: Volume of the added track, 0 to 100.

params.name: in_video_volume
params.description: Volume of the video's own sound under the track, 0 to 100; 0 mutes it.

params.name: in_trial_reel
params.description: Publish the reel as an Instagram trial reel (shown to non-followers first): manual leaves sharing to everyone up to you, performance lets Instagram share it when it does well. Reels only.

params.name: in_product_tags
params.description: Shopping tags on feed images. A JSON array of objects with account_id (encrypted Instagram account), product_id (from /api/instagram_products), image (1-based position in image_url, default 1), x and y (fractions 0 to 1, default 0.5) and optional product_name and product_image for display. Only kept on the Instagram tab.

params.name: in_reel_product_tags
params.description: Shopping tags on a reel. A JSON array of objects with account_id (encrypted Instagram account), product_id (from /api/instagram_products) and optional product_name and image_url for display. Needs in_post_type reel.

params.name: in_is_ai_generated
params.description: Label the Instagram post as AI-generated. Instagram shows its AI label on the post.

params.name: pi_title
params.description: Pin title. The destination link of the pin is url or the first link in the text.
params.example: Summer Sale - Best Deals of the Season

params.name: pi_ai_modified
params.description: Pinterest AI disclosure: the Pin's content was generated or modified with AI.

params.name: pi_synthetic_performer
params.description: Pinterest AI disclosure: a person shown or heard in the Pin is AI-generated.

params.name: gbp_cta
params.description: Call-to-action button on the Google Business post. Case-insensitive. An unknown value or None saves no button. On a link post with no CTA given, Learn more pointing at the link is set automatically.

params.name: gbp_cta_url
params.description: Link the button opens. Not used for Call now. With gbp_cta=Offer and no gbp_redeem_offer_link, this value doubles as the redeem link.

params.name: gbp_offer_title
params.description: Offer title; offer fields are used when gbp_cta is Offer.

params.name: gbp_offer_start_date
params.description: Offer start, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS in the workspace owner's timezone. Stored as sent without a check; the publisher reads the date and the time from it, so a date alone means midnight and a value that is not a date makes the offer fail on Google.

params.name: gbp_offer_end_date
params.description: Offer end, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS in the workspace owner's timezone, after the start. Stored as sent without a check, like the start.

params.name: gbp_offer_coupon_code
params.description: Coupon code shown on the offer.

params.name: gbp_offer_terms
params.description: Terms and conditions of the offer.

params.name: gbp_redeem_offer_link
params.description: Link to redeem the offer.

params.name: yt_title
params.description: Video title. YouTube needs a video_url; message or yt_message is the description.

params.name: yt_category
params.description: Category name, matched exactly against the list. An unknown or missing name falls back to the default category of the workspace owner's YouTube settings (Entertainment when none is set).

params.name: yt_privacy_status
params.description: Video privacy. Lower-cased and stored as given, so use one of the listed values; an unknown value reaches YouTube and fails there. When omitted it is saved as public, and the other YouTube options and the AI label are kept.

params.name: yt_user_tags
params.description: Video tags, comma-separated.

params.name: yt_thumb
params.description: Custom thumbnail URL for the YouTube video. Public image URL; copied to RecurPost storage unless host_images_on_recurpost is off.

params.name: yt_video_made_for_kids
params.description: Whether the video is made for kids. Only yes switches it on.

params.name: yt_contains_synthetic_media
params.description: Tell viewers the video contains realistic content that was altered or generated with AI. YouTube shows a label on the video.

params.name: tk_privacy_status
params.description: Who can watch the TikTok video. Case-insensitive, spaces or underscores. Any other value, or none, is saved as Public to Everyone; the other TikTok options and the AI label are kept either way. /api/tiktok_options lists what the account allows.

params.name: tk_allow_comments
params.description: Allow comments on the TikTok video. Only no switches it off.

params.name: tk_allow_duet
params.description: Allow duets. Only no switches it off.

params.name: tk_allow_stitches
params.description: Allow stitches. Only no switches it off.

params.name: tk_promote_own_brand
params.description: Set to 1 to mark the video as promoting your own brand (TikTok's content disclosure).

params.name: tk_promote_other_brand
params.description: Set to 1 to mark the video as branded content for a third party.

params.name: tk_is_aigc
params.description: Add TikTok's AI-generated content label to the video.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Workspace to act in. Defaults to your default workspace. Get ids from /api/workspace_list. The card is placed in this workspace; without it, or with the owner's signup default workspace, in the first board workspace by name.

endpoints.title: Workflow Post Edit
endpoints.summary: Change a post card: its fields, media and per-network customisations.

params.name: id
params.description: Encrypted post card id from /api/workflow_board (columns[].cards[].id).

params.name: title
params.description: New title; blank or missing keeps the stored one.

params.name: description
params.description: Description or caption draft. Send an empty string to clear it.
params.example: Short teaser for the spring launch.

params.name: platforms
params.description: Platform keys (array, JSON-encoded array string or comma-separated): instagram, facebook, linkedin, twitter, google, pinterest, youtube, tiktok, threads, bluesky.

params.name: account_ids
params.description: Encrypted social account ids (array, JSON array string or comma-separated) the card will publish to. They must be the workspace owner's accounts (404 otherwise), and the app requires them to be attached to the card's workspace. Send an empty string or empty array to clear.

params.name: target_date
params.description: Target date in the owner's wall clock, YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. Send an empty string to clear.

params.name: assignee_user_id
params.description: Encrypted user id from members[] of /api/workflow_board or /api/workflow_card; 0 or an empty string clears the assignee. It must be the owner or an active member of a board workspace (404 otherwise). A person who may not work the card's stage is not assigned: the card is left unassigned, so read assignee on the card.

params.name: share_with_client
params.description: Whether the card is shared with the client for approval. Only the owner and members with Send posts to clients can change it; for anyone else it is ignored. Read client_approval on the card to see what was kept.

params.name: label_ids
params.description: Encrypted label ids of the owner's labels (/api/label_list): an array, a JSON array string or a comma-separated list, at most 50. Replaces the current labels; an empty value clears them.

params.name: media
params.description: Up to 10 attachments as publicly reachable http or https URLs: an array, a JSON array string, a comma-separated string, or one {url, type} object. Each entry is a URL string or {url, type} with type image or video; without a type, .mp4, .mov, .m4v and .webm count as video, everything else as image. Replaces the current media.

params.name: schedule
params.description: Draft schedule slots, one object per slot (an array or a JSON array string): {account_id, at} with at as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM (wall clock of that account's timezone), or {account_id, date, best_time: true} with date as YYYY-MM-DD to let RecurPost pick the best time that day. account_id is an encrypted account id of the owner. Only the owner, the Workspace Manager and members with Publish or schedule may set the schedule; from anyone else the app ignores it without an error. A slot in the past is refused. Replaces the current slots; an empty string or empty list clears them.

params.name: clear_customizations
params.description: true drops every stored per-network customisation of the card; the shared description and media stay. Ignored when customisation fields are sent along.

params.name: image_url
params.description: Shared images for the per-network build, as on /api/post_content: a JSON array, a JSON array string or one URL. Sending it counts as a customisation field. Without it the card's image media is used. The images are fetched into the owner's storage and replace the card's media.

params.name: video_url
params.description: Shared video for the per-network build, as on /api/post_content (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Sending it counts as a customisation field. Without it the card's first video is used. The file is fetched into the owner's storage and becomes part of the card's media.

params.name: url
params.description: Link to share, as on /api/post_content. Counts as a customisation field.

params.name: host_images_on_recurpost
params.description: As on /api/post_content: false keeps your own image URLs instead of copying them to RecurPost storage. Counts as a customisation field.

params.name: alt_text
params.description: Alternative text per image, in image_url order; a single string applies to the first image. At most 1000 characters each. Saved on the Facebook, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Threads and Bluesky tabs; Instagram does not take alt text here.

params.name: fb_image_url
params.description: Images for Facebook accounts instead of image_url, same rules and hosting as image_url. At most 15 images on Facebook. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. Cannot be combined with fb_video_url.

params.name: fb_video_url
params.description: A video for Facebook accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with fb_image_url.

params.name: fb_alt_text
params.description: Alternative text for the fb_image_url images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared alt_text is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

params.name: tw_image_url
params.description: Images for Twitter/X accounts instead of image_url, same rules and hosting as image_url. At most 4 images on Twitter/X. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. Cannot be combined with tw_video_url.

params.name: tw_video_url
params.description: A video for Twitter/X accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with tw_image_url.

params.name: tw_alt_text
params.description: Alternative text for the tw_image_url images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared alt_text is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

params.name: ln_image_url
params.description: Images for LinkedIn accounts instead of image_url, same rules and hosting as image_url. At most 20 images on LinkedIn. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. Cannot be combined with ln_video_url.

params.name: ln_video_url
params.description: A video for LinkedIn accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with ln_image_url.

params.name: ln_alt_text
params.description: Alternative text for the ln_image_url images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared alt_text is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

params.name: in_image_url
params.description: Images for Instagram accounts instead of image_url, same rules and hosting as image_url. At most 10 media in all, images and video together on Instagram. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. May be combined with in_video_url into a carousel; in_media_order sets the order.

params.name: in_video_url
params.description: A video for Instagram accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. May be combined with in_image_url into a carousel.

params.name: in_media_order
params.description: The order of Instagram's own media as a list of the URLs given in in_image_url and in_video_url. Media left out of the list follow, video first. Only read when both are sent. Any other URL answers 400.

params.name: gmb_image_url
params.description: Images for Google Business accounts instead of image_url, same rules and hosting as image_url. At most 1 image on Google Business. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. Cannot be combined with gmb_video_url.

params.name: gmb_video_url
params.description: A video for Google Business accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with gmb_image_url.

params.name: pi_image_url
params.description: Images for Pinterest accounts instead of image_url, same rules and hosting as image_url. At most 1 image on Pinterest. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. Cannot be combined with pi_video_url.

params.name: pi_video_url
params.description: A video for Pinterest accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with pi_image_url.

params.name: pi_alt_text
params.description: Alternative text for the pi_image_url images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared alt_text is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

params.name: yt_video_url
params.description: A video for YouTube accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. YouTube takes a video only, so there is no yt_image_url.

params.name: tk_image_url
params.description: Images for TikTok accounts instead of image_url, same rules and hosting as image_url. At most 10 images on TikTok. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. Cannot be combined with tk_video_url.

params.name: tk_video_url
params.description: A video for TikTok accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with tk_image_url.

params.name: th_image_url
params.description: Images for Threads accounts instead of image_url, same rules and hosting as image_url. At most 20 media in all, images and video together on Threads. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. May be combined with th_video_url into a carousel; th_media_order sets the order.

params.name: th_video_url
params.description: A video for Threads accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. May be combined with th_image_url into a carousel.

params.name: th_media_order
params.description: The order of Threads's own media as a list of the URLs given in th_image_url and th_video_url. Media left out of the list follow, video first. Only read when both are sent. Any other URL answers 400.

params.name: th_alt_text
params.description: Alternative text for the th_image_url images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared alt_text is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

params.name: bs_image_url
params.description: Images for Bluesky accounts instead of image_url, same rules and hosting as image_url. At most 4 images on Bluesky. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. Cannot be combined with bs_video_url.

params.name: bs_video_url
params.description: A video for Bluesky accounts instead of video_url, same rules and hosting as video_url (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with bs_image_url.

params.name: bs_alt_text
params.description: Alternative text for the bs_image_url images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared alt_text is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

params.name: fb_message
params.description: Text for Facebook accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: tw_message
params.description: Text for Twitter/X accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: tw_made_with_ai
params.description: Label the post as made with AI on Twitter/X. X shows the label on the post.

params.name: ln_message
params.description: Text for LinkedIn accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: in_message
params.description: Text for Instagram accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: gmb_message
params.description: Text for Google Business accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: pi_message
params.description: Text for Pinterest accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: yt_message
params.description: Text for YouTube accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview. On YouTube this is the video description.

params.name: tk_message
params.description: Text for TikTok accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: th_message
params.description: Text for Threads accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: bs_message
params.description: Text for Bluesky accounts when it should differ from message. On a text-only post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

params.name: first_comment
params.description: First comment posted right after the post, commonly hashtags. Applied on Facebook Pages, LinkedIn and Instagram feed posts unless a network-specific first comment is given.

params.name: fb_first_comment
params.description: Facebook first comment; overrides first_comment on Facebook.

params.name: ln_first_comment
params.description: LinkedIn first comment; overrides first_comment on LinkedIn.

params.name: in_first_comment
params.description: Instagram first comment (feed posts only); overrides first_comment on Instagram.

params.name: fb_post_type
params.description: Facebook post type. Case-insensitive; an unknown value keeps feed.

params.name: fb_thumb
params.description: Custom cover image URL for the video on Facebook. Public image URL; copied to RecurPost storage unless host_images_on_recurpost is off. Ignored when the post has no video_url.

params.name: fb_mentions
params.description: Facebook pages to mention, up to 10: page ids from /api/mention_search, as a JSON array of ids or of objects with page_id and name. Write @<page id> in the text where each mention should appear; the publisher turns it into the page's mention on Facebook Pages. An id that is not all digits answers 400.

params.name: fb_background_id
params.description: Facebook text background for a post without image_url or video_url: an id from /api/facebook_backgrounds (letters, digits, underscore or dash, up to 64 characters). Applied on Facebook pages only.

params.name: fb_is_ai_generated
params.description: Label the Facebook post as made with AI. On a reel (fb_post_type=reel) Facebook shows its AI label on the reel; on an image post every image on the Facebook tab is labelled as an AI-generated photo, declared by you. Use fb_ai_images to label only some images or to give the provenance type.

params.name: fb_ai_images
params.description: Images to label as AI-generated photos on Facebook, named by the original URLs given in image_url (or fb_image_url when Facebook has its own images). A JSON array of URL strings, or of objects with image_url and provenance_type: EXPLICIT (declared by you, the default), EXPLICIT_AI_EDIT (edited with AI), C2PA (content credentials in the file), IPTC (IPTC AI metadata in the file) or INVISIBLE_WATERMARK. Labels the Facebook tab on its own, without fb_is_ai_generated. A URL that is not one of the post's Facebook images, or any other provenance type, answers 400.

params.name: ln_document
params.description: Public URL of a document to post as a LinkedIn document (carousel) post: PDF, PPT, PPTX, DOC or DOCX, detected from the file bytes, not the file name. The file is downloaded and stored on RecurPost storage and the LinkedIn tab becomes a document post. A file of another type is left as given and ignored by the publisher. Google Drive share links are resolved.

params.name: ln_document_title
params.description: Title shown on the LinkedIn document. Defaults to the file name without its extension.

params.name: ln_thumb
params.description: Custom cover image URL for the video on LinkedIn. Ignored when the post has no video_url.

params.name: in_post_type
params.description: Instagram post type. Case-insensitive; an unknown value keeps feed. A reel needs a video_url.

params.name: in_reel_share_in_feed
params.description: Whether a reel also appears in the profile feed. Only read when in_post_type is reel.

params.name: in_thumb
params.description: Custom cover image URL for an Instagram reel. Only applied when in_post_type is reel and the post has a video_url; copied to RecurPost storage because Meta fetches it at publish time.

params.name: in_location_id
params.description: Instagram place id to tag the post with. Take id and name from /api/instagram_locations. in_location_name is required with it.

params.name: in_location_name
params.description: Name of the place in in_location_id, required with it.

params.name: in_location_city
params.description: City of the tagged place, as returned by /api/instagram_locations.

params.name: in_location_country
params.description: Country of the tagged place, as returned by /api/instagram_locations.

params.name: in_image_tags
params.description: People to tag on feed images. A JSON array of objects with username, x and y (fractions of the image width and height between 0 and 1) and image (1-based position in image_url, default 1). The leading @ is optional. Any entry missing a username, with coordinates outside 0..1 or pointing past the last image answers 400.

params.name: in_reel_tags
params.description: Usernames to tag on a reel, as a JSON array or a comma-separated string. Only saved when the post has a video_url; answers 400 without one.

params.name: in_collaborators
params.description: Instagram usernames invited as collaborators, as a JSON array or a comma-separated string. At most 3; more answer 400.

params.name: in_audio_id
params.description: Music for an Instagram reel: a track id from /api/instagram_audio_search. Needs in_post_type reel, a video_url and in_audio_account_id; ignored on feed and story posts.

params.name: in_audio_account_id
params.description: Encrypted id of the Instagram account the audio search ran for (the account_id in that answer). Required with in_audio_id.

params.name: in_audio_type
params.description: Kind of track, as the search returned it.

params.name: in_audio_title
params.description: Track title from the search, stored for display.

params.name: in_audio_artist
params.description: Artist from the search, stored for display.

params.name: in_audio_duration_ms
params.description: Track length in milliseconds from the search; 0 when omitted.

params.name: in_audio_volume
params.description: Volume of the added track, 0 to 100.

params.name: in_video_volume
params.description: Volume of the video's own sound under the track, 0 to 100; 0 mutes it.

params.name: in_trial_reel
params.description: Publish the reel as an Instagram trial reel (shown to non-followers first): manual leaves sharing to everyone up to you, performance lets Instagram share it when it does well. Reels only.

params.name: in_product_tags
params.description: Shopping tags on feed images. A JSON array of objects with account_id (encrypted Instagram account), product_id (from /api/instagram_products), image (1-based position in image_url, default 1), x and y (fractions 0 to 1, default 0.5) and optional product_name and product_image for display. Only kept on the Instagram tab.

params.name: in_reel_product_tags
params.description: Shopping tags on a reel. A JSON array of objects with account_id (encrypted Instagram account), product_id (from /api/instagram_products) and optional product_name and image_url for display. Needs in_post_type reel.

params.name: in_is_ai_generated
params.description: Label the Instagram post as AI-generated. Instagram shows its AI label on the post.

params.name: pi_title
params.description: Pin title. The destination link of the pin is url or the first link in the text.
params.example: Summer Sale - Best Deals of the Season

params.name: pi_ai_modified
params.description: Pinterest AI disclosure: the Pin's content was generated or modified with AI.

params.name: pi_synthetic_performer
params.description: Pinterest AI disclosure: a person shown or heard in the Pin is AI-generated.

params.name: gbp_cta
params.description: Call-to-action button on the Google Business post. Case-insensitive. An unknown value or None saves no button. On a link post with no CTA given, Learn more pointing at the link is set automatically.

params.name: gbp_cta_url
params.description: Link the button opens. Not used for Call now. With gbp_cta=Offer and no gbp_redeem_offer_link, this value doubles as the redeem link.

params.name: gbp_offer_title
params.description: Offer title; offer fields are used when gbp_cta is Offer.

params.name: gbp_offer_start_date
params.description: Offer start, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS in the workspace owner's timezone. Stored as sent without a check; the publisher reads the date and the time from it, so a date alone means midnight and a value that is not a date makes the offer fail on Google.

params.name: gbp_offer_end_date
params.description: Offer end, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS in the workspace owner's timezone, after the start. Stored as sent without a check, like the start.

params.name: gbp_offer_coupon_code
params.description: Coupon code shown on the offer.

params.name: gbp_offer_terms
params.description: Terms and conditions of the offer.

params.name: gbp_redeem_offer_link
params.description: Link to redeem the offer.

params.name: yt_title
params.description: Video title. YouTube needs a video_url; message or yt_message is the description.

params.name: yt_category
params.description: Category name, matched exactly against the list. An unknown or missing name falls back to the default category of the workspace owner's YouTube settings (Entertainment when none is set).

params.name: yt_privacy_status
params.description: Video privacy. Lower-cased and stored as given, so use one of the listed values; an unknown value reaches YouTube and fails there. When omitted it is saved as public, and the other YouTube options and the AI label are kept.

params.name: yt_user_tags
params.description: Video tags, comma-separated.

params.name: yt_thumb
params.description: Custom thumbnail URL for the YouTube video. Public image URL; copied to RecurPost storage unless host_images_on_recurpost is off.

params.name: yt_video_made_for_kids
params.description: Whether the video is made for kids. Only yes switches it on.

params.name: yt_contains_synthetic_media
params.description: Tell viewers the video contains realistic content that was altered or generated with AI. YouTube shows a label on the video.

params.name: tk_privacy_status
params.description: Who can watch the TikTok video. Case-insensitive, spaces or underscores. Any other value, or none, is saved as Public to Everyone; the other TikTok options and the AI label are kept either way. /api/tiktok_options lists what the account allows.

params.name: tk_allow_comments
params.description: Allow comments on the TikTok video. Only no switches it off.

params.name: tk_allow_duet
params.description: Allow duets. Only no switches it off.

params.name: tk_allow_stitches
params.description: Allow stitches. Only no switches it off.

params.name: tk_promote_own_brand
params.description: Set to 1 to mark the video as promoting your own brand (TikTok's content disclosure).

params.name: tk_promote_other_brand
params.description: Set to 1 to mark the video as branded content for a third party.

params.name: tk_is_aigc
params.description: Add TikTok's AI-generated content label to the video.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Workspace to act in. Defaults to your default workspace. Get ids from /api/workspace_list. Picks the board owner; the card may sit on any workspace of that board you belong to.

endpoints.summary: Add a comment to a card's activity, optionally as an internal note.

endpoints.title: Workflow Stage Save
endpoints.summary: Add a stage to the workflow or change one.

params.name: stage_id
params.description: Encrypted stage id from stages[].id of /api/workflow_settings_get: the stage to change. Omit it to add one.

params.name: name
params.description: Required when adding: stage name, 1 to 60 characters. On a change, a sent value replaces the name (blank is refused).

params.name: type
params.description: Required when adding: work, review or client, case-insensitive. On a change it defaults to the current type.

params.name: color
params.description: blue, orange, teal, green, purple, red, yellow or pink, case-insensitive. Defaults to blue when adding and to the current color on a change.

params.name: position
params.description: Only when adding: place in the board order, 1 first (default 1). A work or review stage asked for after the Client Review stage is put in its slot, so Client Review stays last. Ignored on a change: an existing stage keeps its place.

params.name: timeout_hours
params.description: Hours before the timeout policy runs: 0 for none, or one of 4, 8, 24, 48, 72, 168. Defaults to 0 when adding and to the current value on a change.

params.name: timeout_policy
params.description: What happens when the timeout passes: hold, auto_approve, escalate, or reschedule on the client stage only. Read only when timeout_hours is not 0; defaults to the current policy, else hold.

params.name: reschedule_by_days
params.description: With the reschedule policy: how many days the post is pushed by, 1 to 30. Defaults to the current value, else 1.

params.name: reject_to_stage_id
params.description: On the client stage: encrypted id (from stages[].id) of the stage a post the client rejects goes back to. It must be an earlier work or review stage of the workflow; any other stage is dropped silently and reads back as an empty string in stages[]. Ignored on a work or review stage.

params.name: roles
params.description: The roles that work the stage, as encrypted role ids or role names (case-insensitive), from /api/roles; a JSON array, a form array or a comma-separated string. Replaces the current roles; send an empty list to clear them. Left out on a change, the current roles stay. Ignored on a client stage, which has none.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Workspace to act in. Defaults to your default workspace. Get ids from /api/workspace_list. The workflow is account-wide; you must own the workspace.
